title: Account Specialist, Spacisity & Movement Disorder - Bethesda/Rockville, MD
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
Describe the primary goals, objectives or functions or outputs of this position.
The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy. Or in Urology, specialists such as urology, urogynecology, obstetrics and gynecology, female pelvic medicine, ambulatory surgical centers, and reconstructive surgery.
Responsibilities
Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
Ability to lift/pull 25–100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.

title: Asset Strategy Leader, R&D Aesthetics
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Asset Strategy Leader is an experienced and established leader with the ability to influence across multiple functions and levels within Abbvie who serves as the matrix leader with overall accountability for an asset from discovery to end of life cycle.  He / she guides and directs the creation and execution of a comprehensive asset strategy and phase appropriate brand strategies for one or multiple asset(s).  This responsibility requires consideration and integration of all functional activities relevant to the successful development, registration, manufacture and commercialization, of the asset throughout its lifecycle with specific emphasis on ensuring an integrated strategy across these elements.  Serving as the primary face of the asset at AbbVie, the Asset Strategy Leader works with governance, functional leaders, and other cross-functional groups and external development partners, to advance and optimize the value of the asset consistent with its prioritization in the overall portfolio. This is not an entry point to a leadership position, but will require someone with a broad exposure to all the activities involved in successfully developing and launching assets and brands (Development, Discovery, Development Sciences, Operations, Commercial, Market Access, Regulatory, Safety, Project Management, Medical Affairs, etc., and substantial cross-functional interaction during your career) to draw upon past experiences that will provide the best outcomes for the progress, registration, reimbursement and life cycle of one or more assets or brands.  The position will require broad leadership skills with enterprise level thinking.
This position is based on site at one of AbbVie’s main locations (e.g., Irvine, Lake County, San Fransisco, New Jersey).
Responsibilities
Chairs an Asset Strategy Team (AST).  In this capacity, serves as the enterprise leader who is the project’s primary point of contact for Pipeline Governance and senior management.
Has a broad vision for the asset and leads the effort to create, articulate and gain endorsement of an integrated cross-functional Global Asset Strategy and Brand Strategy for all aspects of product development, commercialization and lifecycle management and ensures timely, multidirectional and comprehensive interactions with Pipeline Governance within the Pipeline Operating Model, including close liaison with the key governance bodies of Aesthetics Device Governance Board, Tri-Function Review and other ad hoc governance requests within Abbvie.
Ability to put asset recommendations in context of Abbvie’s enterprise objectives
Maintains primary responsibility for the ensuing deliverables, including a functionally aligned Global Asset Strategy and Product Development Plan (PDP).Reviews and analyzes emerging data objectively to drive team toward recommendations that highlight opportunities, address potential risks and proactively provide appropriate mitigations.
Builds strong, collaborative peer-to-peer relationships with governance team members and executives to enable optimal timely, multi-directional, and comprehensive interactions with PCM Governance at pre-specified milestones and as program issues or opportunities arise.
Has a deep understanding of the role and value of each function on the team, to know how to solicit timely input.  Collaborates with AST functions to ensure program is appropriately resourced and stays within allocated budget and champions requests for incremental resources when appropriate.  Works continually with supporting teams to ensure that strategy and executed plans are consistent with the Target Product Profile (TPP), Asset Plan and PDP, tracking progress in conjunction with the Portfolio Project Manager, with attention to committed timeline and budget.
Ensures that the AST continually validates the viability of the program from a scientific and commercial perspective.  Develops clear, prospective Go/No-Go decision points and serves as a champion for the program, using objectivity and judgment to analyze, interpret and present data to Pipeline Governance and senior management.
Strategic advisor to cross-functional teams (e.g., Global Brand Team, CMC, Integrated evidence strategy team, Value and Access team, Regulatory strategy, etc.). Ensure development and alignment with deliverable team co-chairs for key plan deliverables such as the Integrated Evidence Plan, Regulatory Strategy plans, Brand plans, Operations LRP plans.
Establishes close, ongoing ties with across Asset and deliverable team members and enables a culture of inclusivity, psychological safety, and empowerment. Maintains a function-neutral position in prioritizing actions and making decisions, with an eye toward optimizing asset and portfolio value in a timely and high-quality fashion. Coaches and mentors team members, consistent with the High Performing Teams (HPT) model. Enables the AST to focus on strategy and decision-making, and optimal communication of issues to support teams and leadership.
Represents the AST at interactions with external parties (e.g., Advisory Boards, regulatory interactions) when these engagements require broad cross-functional contributions. Exhibits exceptional executive presence and clear communication with all levels of management.
Works with team members to maintain a comprehensive and up-to-date understanding of the competitive environment in the field and to assess for potential impact on ongoing programs. Stays abreast of professional information, industry trends, and emerging technology through conferences, medical literature, and training to augment expertise in drug development and the pharmaceutical industry. Develops a comprehensive understanding of how AbbVie’s assets are positioned relative to competitor assets
Understands what’s important and focuses the team and stakeholders there as well. Asks the right question and seeks all points of view in order to find the best path forward.
Bachelor’s Degree required; Advanced (Doctoral-level or MBA) degree highly preferred.
Relevant experience (minimum of 5 years to 8 years; 10+ years preferred) as a leader in a pharmaceutical/biotech Commercial, R&D, Regulatory or Operations setting; deep expertise in a relevant discipline associated with drug development and /or commercialization and ideally experienced in multiple areas of the industry, often with multiple therapy areas, phases of development.
Demonstrated a high-level of strategic thinking, leadership, and problem-solving, with the ability to swiftly apply new knowledge to asset strategy and enterprise priorities.
Ideally experienced across multiple device product development, particular emphasis on aesthetics programs.
Have had the experience of following a single asset and associated brands through all the phases of the development and commercialization of a single asset will be preferred but achieving as an aggregate of experience across multiple assets is also acceptable.
Demonstrated ability to lead. motivate and elicit top performance from teams in a cross functional, highly matrixed pharmaceutical/biotech environment, preferably with global scope, in any discipline which involves a broad understanding of all phases of drug commercialization.
Ability to objectively exercise judgment and create pragmatic solutions to address complex cross-functional problems, and to be accountable for obtaining stakeholder advice to make informed decisions, to move a program forward in the face of uncertainty or incomplete data. Can stand alone or take unpopular decisions to ensure appropriate organizational decisions.
Demonstrated ability to communicate with and influence senior executives
Experience of how different elements (discovery, development, regulatory, commercial etc.) fit together in the drug commercialization lifecycle and has demonstrable ability to rapidly assimilate new knowledge of relevance to drug development and commercialization
Deep expertise in the strategy and execution for commercialization of drugs including R&D, Regulatory, Commercial and /or Manufacturing
Ability to objectively exercise judgment and create pragmatic solutions to address complex cross-functional problems and to be accountable for obtaining stakeholder advice to make informed decisions, in order to move a program forward in the face of uncertainty or incomplete data. Ability to delegate appropriate accountability and decision-making to supporting teams and functions.

The Precision Medicine Immunology group is seeking an experienced translational and biomarker scientist with expertise in immunology to lead the development, planning, execution, and interpretation of precision medicine activities supporting AbbVie’s immunology clinical development portfolio.

Translational and biomarker strategy: Lead the development and implementation of translational and biomarker strategies for one or more clinical programs, spanning early translational development, mature product life cycle planning, and back-translational research.

Cross-functional leadership: Lead asset-specific translational projects and teams within a matrixed environment.
Operational coordination: Partner with the internal Operations group to coordinate sample management, assay validation at internal laboratories and external CROs, statement-of-work reviews, and data management.
Program planning and compliance: Collaborate with key stakeholders to incorporate translational budgets, timelines, publication strategies, and regulatory compliance requirements into program strategy.
Clinical and regulatory documentation: Author and review the translational medicine components of development plans, study protocols, clinical study reports, regulatory submissions, and other clinical and regulatory documents.

Data analysis and visualization: Familiarity with data management and visualization tools, with experience collaborating with computational biologists to analyze complex clinical trial data sets.
Therapeutic-area expertise: Expertise in rheumatology is highly desirable.
Clinical development knowledge: Knowledge of clinical trial methodology, protocol design, regulatory requirements governing clinical trials, companion diagnostics, and development strategy is preferred.
Program and team management: Ability to manage clinical translational programs and cross-functional teams with moderate supervision.
Communication and organization: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present results clearly and concisely. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective time management, and adaptability to changing priorities are essential.

This role will translate brand strategy into practical, high-impact execution, with a strong focus on field activation, close partnership with sales leadership and field teams, and the continuous development and optimization of customer-facing assets. The Associate Director will connect customer and field insights to brand decisions, ensure teams are equipped to execute effectively, and adapt plans and materials based on market response and performance.

Own the end-to-end brand plan for TrenibotE, from launch strategy and readiness through post-launch optimization, lifecycle planning, and day-to-day brand management.
Translate brand strategy into clear execution priorities, field-facing plans, and practical guidance that enable consistent, high-quality customer engagement.
Partner closely with sales leadership, sales training, and field teams to prepare for launch, gather real-time market feedback, identify execution barriers, and refine tactics.
Maintain a strong in-field presence through field rides, regional and national sales meetings, customer engagements, and regular collaboration with field teams to understand customer needs and improve execution.
Provide ongoing direction, tools, and coaching resources to help field teams confidently communicate the brand value proposition and execute against brand priorities.
Lead the development, approval, deployment, and ongoing refresh of post-launch promotional assets, sales tools, campaigns, educational resources, and customer experiences for healthcare professionals and consumers.
Use field insights, customer feedback, market research, competitive intelligence, and performance data to optimize messaging, assets, channels, and tactical plans after launch.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Consumer, Digital, Analytics, and Operations to ensure launch readiness and disciplined post-launch execution.
Manage agency partners, budgets, timelines, and production workflows to deliver high-quality assets and programs with speed, accuracy, and operational excellence.
Establish and monitor launch and post-launch performance measures, communicate progress and risks, and recommend course corrections to achieve brand objectives.
Represent the brand in planning, forecasting, business reviews, and lifecycle discussions, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and field execution.
Build productive relationships with key opinion leaders, customers, advocacy partners, and external experts to support adoption and inform continued brand development.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; MBA preferred.
8+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical aesthetics, or healthcare marketing, including meaningful product launch and post-launch brand management experience.
Demonstrated ability to own a brand strategy while driving disciplined, high-quality tactical execution.
Strong experience partnering with sales leadership and field teams, translating strategy into actionable guidance, and incorporating field insights into brand decisions.
Proven success developing and optimizing promotional assets, sales tools, campaigns, and educational resources in a regulated environment.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams, agencies, and complex workstreams with clear priorities, accountability, and timely decision-making.
Deep understanding of facial aesthetics market dynamics, customer needs and journeys, competitive trends, and the regulatory landscape.
Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Associate Director, Change Management & Enablement
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose:
The Change Management & Enablement Associate Director plays a critical role in driving Finance Transformation programs forward as part of enterprise-wide culture and behavior change to enable sustainable adoption of new processes, ways of working, and operating models within AbbVie Finance.  This role goes beyond project delivery to focus on embedding change into the organization’s DNA, ensuring that employees not only adopt new tools and processes, but also embrace the mindsets, behaviors, and cultural shifts required to sustain transformation.
The individual will lead the design and execution of integrated change strategies that influence leadership alignment, employee engagement, and process adoption, ultimately accelerating value realization and long-term organizational effectiveness.
Responsibilities:
Culture & Behavior Change Leadership
Lead Finance Transformation initiatives that drive mindset and behavior change, reinforcing a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and adaptability.
Partner with senior leaders to model and reinforce desired cultural attributes and ways of working.
Work with SMEs to translate transformation objectives into clear behavioral expectations and adoption milestones.
Process & Adoption Transformation
Drive end-to-end adoption of new processes and operating models, ensuring alignment across people, process, and technology.
Identify and address barriers to adoption, focusing on sustainable behavior change vs. one-time implementation.
Embed change into business routines, governance forums, and performance management where appropriate.
Integrated Change Strategy & Execution
Develop and execute holistic change strategies that integrate communications, training, stakeholder engagement, and reinforcement mechanisms.
Apply structured change management methodologies to support both large-scale transformations and targeted process improvements.
Ensure alignment of change activities across cross-functional teams and initiatives.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership Alignment
Build strong, trusted partnerships with senior leaders and project teams to drive alignment, sponsorship, and accountability.
Conduct stakeholder and readiness assessments to inform targeted interventions.
Act as a strategic advisor to leaders on navigating organizational change and resistance.
Measurement & Continuous Improvement
Define and track adoption, behavior change, and culture metrics to measure success.
Leverage data and insights to continuously refine change strategies and improve outcomes.
Capability Building & Enablement
Design and deliver training that supports not just knowledge transfer, but behavioral and mindset shifts.
Coach managers and teams to effectively lead and sustain change.
10+ years of experience leading organizational change, culture transformation, or process adoption initiatives.
Proven ability to drive behavior change and embed new ways of working in complex, cross-functional environments.
Experience partnering with senior leadership to influence culture, alignment, and decision-making.
Strong understanding of change management methodologies (e.g., PROSCI, ACMP), with ability to apply them pragmatically.
Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.
Experience designing and measuring adoption and culture-related success metrics.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Communications, Organizational Development, Education).

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Position Summary
The Associate Director, Chief of Staff – People Experience (PE) serves as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the PE Leadership Team, driving the execution and acceleration of the People Experience vision. This role is a core member of the PE leadership team, responsible for optimizing the PE organization itself — how it operates, prioritizes, plans, and delivers against its agenda. The Chief of Staff acts as an integrator, communicator, and accelerator, translating PE's vision into tangible outcomes and ensuring the PE team functions at its highest potential.
Note: This role is focused on PE organizational optimization — not broad HR optimization, which is a shared accountability across the entire PE team. The Chief of Staff ensures PE as an organization runs with excellence, coherence, and strategic clarity.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Vision Acceleration
Partner with the Head of People Experience and PE leadership to define, refine, and cascade the PE vision and multi-year strategy.
Identify and resolve strategic gaps, dependencies, and opportunities that affect execution of the PE agenda.
Serve as a thought partner to senior PE leaders, bringing an enterprise perspective and anticipating organizational needs before they arise.
Synthesize complex information and distill it into clear, compelling narratives for leadership and stakeholders.
PE Organizational Optimization
Own the continuous improvement of how the PE organization operates — including how the team is structured to deliver, how decisions get made, and how work gets done.
Drive clarity on roles, accountabilities, and interdependencies across PE sub-functions to eliminate duplication and increase team effectiveness.
Identify operational inefficiencies within PE and implement scalable solutions to improve team performance and output quality.
Partner with PE leaders to assess and evolve the operating model as the team's scope and strategy evolve.
Note: Broad HR optimization (e.g., improving HR programs and services for the enterprise) is a shared responsibility across the entire PE team. This role is specifically accountable for optimizing the PE organization itself.
Prioritization & Portfolio Management
Lead and manage the PE Leadership Team's portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment to top priorities and business outcomes.
Drive rigorous prioritization frameworks to focus PE resources on the highest-value work.
Track progress against strategic goals and OKRs; escalate risks and recommend course corrections as needed.
Partner with Finance and HR Operations on PE resource planning and investment decisions.
Rhythms of Business & Operating Model
Design, own, and continuously improve the rhythms of business for the PE organization, including leadership team meetings, planning cycles, business reviews, and all-hands communications.
Prepare and curate agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up actions for PE Leadership Team meetings to ensure productive, outcome-oriented sessions.
Coordinate and manage annual and quarterly planning processes, connecting PE plans to broader AbbVie enterprise cycles.
Build and maintain a PE operating calendar that ensures key milestones, deliverables, and decisions are managed proactively.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as a connector across PE sub-functions, breaking down silos and ensuring integrated execution of the PE strategy.
Represent the PE Leadership Team in cross-functional forums, working groups, and enterprise planning processes.
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across HR, Business HR, Finance, Communications, and other enabling functions.
Communications & Change Enablement
Develop compelling internal communications for the PE organization, including leadership messages, town halls, strategy updates, and culture-building content.
Champion change management best practices to support adoption of new PE programs, processes, and ways of working within the PE team.
Elevate the PE team's visibility and brand across the enterprise through strategic storytelling and engagement.
Team Effectiveness & Culture
Foster a high-performing, inclusive team culture within the PE Leadership Team and broader PE organization.
Lead special projects and initiatives that strengthen PE organizational effectiveness, engagement, and capability building.
Act as a culture carrier for the PE vision — modeling AbbVie's values and the behaviors the PE team aspires to enable.
Required
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
7+ years of progressive experience in HR, strategy, operations, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience operating at a senior level and influencing without direct authority.
Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Strong executive communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to synthesize complexity for senior audiences.
High learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and comfort navigating ambiguity.
Preferred
MBA or advanced degree.
Prior Chief of Staff, HR Strategy, or HR Business Partner experience at a large, matrixed organization.
Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences industry.
Familiarity with organizational design, change management, and workforce planning methodologies.
Competencies
Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
Influence & Stakeholder Management
Executive Presence & Communication
Execution Discipline & Prioritization
Collaboration & Integration
Learning Agility & Innovation Mindset
Inclusive Leadership
Why People Experience at AbbVie
The People Experience team is at the heart of how AbbVie attracts, develops, and retains the world-class talent needed to deliver on its mission. As a member of the PE Leadership Team, the Associate Director, Chief of Staff will have a front-row seat to enterprise-wide transformation — with a unique opportunity to shape how the PE organization operates and delivers its vision for AbbVie's people now and into the future.

description:

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. Position Overview
We are seeking an accomplished scientific leader in AI-enabled computational biology to establish and advance next-generation immunogenicity and translational immunology capabilities across biologics discovery and development. The successful candidate will serve as a discipline expert and strategic partner, combining machine learning, protein language models, structural modeling, systems immunology, and computational biology to predict, understand, and mitigate anti-drug antibody (ADA) responses and other immune-mediated liabilities across therapeutic proteins, multispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, gene therapies, and novel modalities.
This individual will define scientific strategy, lead high-impact cross-functional programs, build fit-for-purpose computational capabilities, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for project teams, governance bodies, and senior leaders. The role includes direct people leadership and accountability for developing an effective, collaborative, and scientifically excellent team.
Key Responsibilities
Scientific Strategy and Functional Leadership
Develop and deliver the computational immunogenicity strategy in alignment with Development Sciences priorities and key scientific objectives.
Serve as the discipline expert and primary contact for AI/ML-enabled immunogenicity, protein engineering, and translational modeling.
Identify emerging scientific and technology trends, assess their relevance, and translate them into short- and long-term functional objectives.
Create, champion, and implement innovative approaches that improve candidate selection, risk mitigation, and transition success.
AI/ML-Based Immunogenicity and Protein Modeling
Lead development and deployment of predictive models for preclinical and clinical immunogenicity risk assessment.
Integrate ADA incidence, PK/PD, HLA, sequence, structure, developability, assay, and patient-level data using machine learning and deep learning approaches.
Apply protein language models, foundation models, transformers, generative AI, and physics-informed modeling to identify immunogenicity drivers, biomarkers, and design opportunities.
Develop or guide methods to predict ADA incidence and persistence, T-cell epitope content, HLA-associated risk, patient susceptibility, and drug-like properties of biologics.
Systems Immunology, Multi-Omics, and Translational Modeling
Integrate transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial biology, flow cytometry, bioanalytical, and clinical datasets to characterize immune responses to biologics.
Build computational frameworks linking in vitro and ex vivo assays, nonclinical observations, molecular mechanisms, and clinical ADA or neutralizing-antibody outcomes.
Identify biomarkers associated with immune activation, tolerance, and ADA development, and use findings to inform translational and clinical strategies.
Generative AI, Knowledge Integration, and Data Platforms
Lead development of PLM- and LLM-enabled tools for scientific knowledge mining, hypothesis generation, and immunogenicity risk assessment.
Guide retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows that use scientific literature, historical studies, internal reports, and regulatory guidance.
Establish integrated, traceable immunogenicity data assets and scalable data pipelines spanning discovery, nonclinical, and clinical development.
Ensure analytical approaches are reproducible, scientifically defensible, appropriately documented, and fit for their intended use.
Cross-Functional Influence and Communication
Collaborate with experts across Discovery, Protein Sciences, Bioanalysis, Clinical, Regulatory, Toxicology, Data Science, and other Development Sciences functions.
Communicate complex scientific concepts, model performance, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Present scientific strategies and results to project teams, functional leadership, governance committees, senior management, and internal or external partners.
Build strong working relationships, reconcile differing technical perspectives, and influence decisions through evidence-based recommendations.
People Leadership and Talent Development
Manage, mentor, and develop a team of computational scientists and/or computational protein engineers; set clear priorities and maintain accountability for high-quality delivery.
Provide technical guidance, performance coaching, career development, and timely feedback to direct reports.
Create an inclusive, collaborative environment that encourages scientific rigor, innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.
Assess capability needs and help build the talent, partnerships, and operating model required to achieve functional goals.
Required Qualifications
Ph.D. in computational biology, computational structural biology, bioinformatics, biomedical informatics, computer science, data science, biophysics, or a related scientific field, with typically 8 or more years of related work experience; or a Master’s degree with typically 14 or more years.
Demonstrated discipline expertise in computational protein science, biologics discovery or development, AI/ML, and predictive modeling.
Proven ability to define scientific strategy, lead complex multidisciplinary programs, and deliver innovative computational capabilities with measurable scientific or product impact.
Demonstrated people-management experience, including leading scientific teams, setting priorities, coaching employees, and supporting performance and career development.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to scientific, non-scientific, and senior-leadership audiences.
Strong record of collaboration and influence across diverse internal and external groups.
Experience with HLA binding prediction, T-cell epitope prediction, MHC-II modeling, single-cell analysis, knowledge graphs, causal AI, RAG systems, or biomedical language models.
Experience handling, curating, integrating, and governing large experimental, biological, clinical, structural, or multi-omics datasets.
Experience developing and maintaining reproducible data pipelines, automated workflows, and deployable computational tools.
Demonstrated understanding of physical principles governing protein structure, folding, binding, developability, and molecular recognition.
Scientific and Technical Expertise
Protein language models, generative protein design, structural modeling, and computational antibody engineering.
Biologics developability, property prediction, sequence and structure optimization, and translational decision support.
Immunology, adaptive immune responses, ADA and neutralizing-antibody biology, immune tolerance, and translational medicine.
Proficiency in Python and relevant scientific computing, data science, and machine-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or XGBoost.
Cloud or scalable computing environments such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, or Snowflake, and effective scientific data visualization.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with immunogenicity risk assessment, ADA data interpretation, and relevant FDA or EMA guidance.
Experience converting computational prototypes into tools that are adopted by research or development teams.
Publication, patent, invited-presentation, or other record demonstrating scientific innovation and external or internal recognition.
Experience building collaborations across computational, experimental, translational, and clinical disciplines.
Critical Success Factors
Strategic scientific leadership paired with hands-on technical depth.
Innovation that produces practical, trusted, and scalable solutions for biologics development.
Clear, concise, and influential communication across levels and disciplines.
Effective people leadership, talent development, and team accountability.
Sound scientific judgment, early risk assessment, and transparent communication of model limitations.
Ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced, and goal-driven environment.

title: Director, National Accounts -Allergan Aesthetics
description:
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
Role Purpose
The Director, National Accounts (DNA) is responsible for strategically managing the organization’s largest and most influential Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs) and national accounts. This role brings a national, enterprise-wide perspective to customer strategy, contract management and commercial growth.
The DNA serves as a critical bridge between the company’s long-term business strategy and the realities of the national healthcare marketplace. Through sophisticated account management, contract negotiations, market intelligence and cross-functional leadership, the DNA helps shape how the organization competes, grows and positions itself for the future.
This role leads through influence, expertise and accountability rather than direct authority , mobilizing internal and external stakeholders around complex national priorities.
Key Responsibilities
National Account & GPO Strategy
Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year strategies for the company’s largest and most strategically important GPO and national accounts.
Maintain a national perspective on customer needs, market dynamics, competitive activity, contracting trends and emerging opportunities.
Understand the broader implications of GPO decisions across the organization, including impact on customers, field sales, pricing, contracts, market access and long-term growth.
Translate national account insights into actionable recommendations that influence the company’s long-term commercial strategy.
Identify emerging risks and opportunities early and proactively develop strategies to address them.
Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leadership on the implications of national account and GPO relationships.
Complex Contract Negotiation & Commercial Strategy
Lead complex, high-value contract negotiations with GPOs and national customers.
Develop negotiation strategies that balance customer requirements, competitive dynamics, financial objectives and long-term business priorities.
Demonstrate a sophisticated understanding of contract terms and conditions, including pricing structures, commitments, obligations, performance requirements, compliance considerations and commercial risk.
Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales, Contracting and other internal functions to evaluate contractual opportunities and risks.
Develop and communicate recommendations that support sound, sustainable commercial decisions.
Understand how individual contract decisions may affect broader customer relationships and the company’s overall market position.
RFP Leadership & Business Development
Lead the coordination and execution of complex national RFPs from strategy through submission and negotiation.
Develop compelling, differentiated responses that reflect the customer’s business priorities and the company’s strategic objectives.
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure accurate, timely and cohesive RFP responses.
Develop executive-level presentations, proposals and business cases that clearly communicate value and support strategic decisions.
Engage directly with GPO account executives and other key stakeholders to identify opportunities, strengthen relationships and advance the business.
Enterprise & Cross-Functional Leadership
Lead through influence and accountability without relying on direct reporting relationships.
Bring together stakeholders across Sales, Corporate Healthcare, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Contracting, Operations, Medical/Clinical and other functions to align around national account objectives.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, timelines and decision points for complex initiatives.
Challenge assumptions, provide informed recommendations and respectfully push back when necessary.
Recognize when issues require escalation and bring forward solutions and a clear recommended path forward.
Ensure national account strategies are translated into coordinated execution across the organization.
Partnership with Corporate Healthcare & Field Sales
Serve as a strategic partner to Directors of Corporate Accounts (DCAs), providing expertise and perspective on GPO dynamics, national contracting and enterprise implications.
Assist DCAs in developing account strategies , particularly where GPO agreements, national relationships or contracting decisions influence the broader account.
Provide guidance and insight to the Strategic Account Management (SAM) process and help ensure national account strategy is incorporated into broader enterprise account planning.
Partner with the field sales organization to translate national account agreements and strategies into effective field execution.
Provide guidance to field sales teams when an account is not directly managed by Corporate Healthcare but is impacted by a national or GPO relationship.
Help the field understand the strategic implications of national agreements, customer requirements and contracting decisions.
Customer & Relationship Leadership
Develop trusted relationships with GPO account executives and other senior customer stakeholders.
Understand the customer’s business model, strategic priorities, economic pressures and evolving needs.
Engage customers as a strategic business partner rather than solely as a supplier or contract counterparty.
Identify opportunities to expand relationships beyond the immediate contract or transaction.
Maintain regular customer engagement, including meaningful face-to-face interactions where they will advance the relationship or business strategy.
Market & Healthcare Expertise
Maintain a strong and current understanding of the healthcare market, including GPO dynamics, IDNs, hospital economics, reimbursement pressures, competitive trends and evolving purchasing models.
Understand how changes in the healthcare landscape may affect GPO strategy, customer behavior and the company’s commercial opportunities.
Monitor industry trends and translate external developments into implications for the business.
Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive environment and how the company is positioned within the market.
Core Capabilities
The successful Director, National Accounts demonstrates:
National strategic perspective: understands how individual GPOs and national accounts fit into the broader healthcare ecosystem and company strategy.
Long-term strategic planning: develops multi-year strategies while balancing immediate business needs with long-term objectives.
Contracting & negotiation expertise: confidently navigates complex agreements, terms and conditions, commercial structures and negotiations.
Enterprise business acumen: understands the financial, operational and strategic implications of national account decisions.
Influence without authority: creates alignment, drives accountability and moves complex initiatives forward without relying on direct reporting relationships.
Executive communication & presentation: communicates complex information clearly and persuasively to senior internal and external audiences.
RFP leadership: can develop strategy, coordinate stakeholders and lead high-quality responses to complex national RFPs.
Relationship leadership: builds credibility and trusted partnerships with GPO executives, internal leaders and field organizations.
Analytical & commercial thinking: connects customer data, market trends, contract economics and business performance to develop sound recommendations.
Judgment & decision-making: knows when to challenge, when to collaborate and when to escalate.
Healthcare expertise: understands the structure, economics and evolving dynamics of the healthcare market.
Executional discipline: translates strategy into clear actions, ownership, timelines and measurable outcomes.
Qualifications
* Years of experience: 5-10 in Corporate Healthcare covering IDN or GPO’s
* Bachelor’s required in business, marketing or medical related major
* At least 5 years of medical device experience
3 years of medical sales management and GPO/IDN contracting experience in health care or related experience
Experience with negotiating custom contracts and selling value. Demonstrated track record of sales/contracting success in large accounts. Experience with Microsoft Office applications including: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, & Outlook
Experience National Account Strategic Plans. Experience with business strategy and key drivers for effective training programs. Experience with health care industry sales
Demonstrated management, coaching and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated presentation and communication skills. Ability to understand and communicate economic and clinical information. Ability to develop and maintain senior account relationships
Ability to work cross-functionally to achieve business goals. Ability to help set goals and strategic objectives, then balance short-term goals with a strategic vision
Ability to travel 50-75%. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in business relationships

5 years’ experience in warehousing, distribution, and/or supply chain management

Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. The leader of Allergan Aesthetics Sales Training and Management Development is responsible for effectively onboarding and developing the AA sales organization, onboarding and in-role development.  This includes the development of the AA portfolio sales representatives, management development program and development of people leaders within the US commercial organization.  To ensure alignment with the strategic objectives of AA, this leader is responsible for the strategic execution of sales and marketing initiatives through training, development and national meetings for the Facial Aesthetics and Inside Sales (Facial, SkinMedica, PRM and Body Contouring) divisions. Focus is on ensuring the current and future training and development needs of the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio sales teams are met covering clinical technique across multiple medical devices/pharmaceutical products and procedures, clinical training across multiple product lines, Alle platform, Business Development, Patient Engagement, AMI Customer Clinical Training programs and Customer Business Programs (APC  and ADC Consulting Services), Business Development and strategic resource deployment. Is responsible for cross-functional partnership and alignment with the Brand Marketing and US Meetings team to strategize, develop workshops and execute all sales meetings (Manager Meetings, National Sales Meeting, and Launch Meetings as needed) to prepare sales team to execute on key objectives to achieve sales performance objectives. Manages the Portfolio content training throughout the new hire curriculum of Foundations, Competitive Boot Camp, Business Development and Advanced Business Development for all of the divisions in Allergan Aesthetics. Ensures unique curriculum development to develop the skills and capabilities needed to achieve business unit specific objectives and responsibilities.
60%- Plans, develops and directs the execution of all training and development programs for the US Aesthetics Sales Teams, including the onboarding of new sales representatives, development training for existing sales representatives and management and leadership development training programs to develop a pipeline of future people managers.
These responsibilities include strategic oversight of the following key areas of sales training and mgt development:  Clinical Expertise and selling skills across of the AA Portfolio :  Strategy and execution of the effective onboarding and development of the Allergan Aesthetic Sales organization.  Guides Clinical Training across multiple devices and pharmaceutical products for both internal team clinical training and external customer training programs.

Collaborates across the organization to develop and update appropriate content and execution for AA Sales Teams (Facial, SKM, Body Contouring, PRM, and Inside Sales).

Minimum of 5+ years leading leaders of teams to achieve training, sales or marketing objectives.

Excellent cross-functional partnership skills and ability to work effectively to drive alignment in a matrix organization.
Strong leadership skills to direct the effective development of entry level to Sr. level skills across the sales organization.
Excellent communication skills, oral and written at a senior leadership level.  The ability to present to various levels and sizes of groups within and outside of the organization.

description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Lead Site Reliability Engineer will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on technical leader driving reliability, availability, and operational excellence for large-scale public-facing software. As part of the Cloud Platform team, you will own how we measure, protect, and improve production reliability — championing SRE practices, building resilience into our platform, and ensuring our services meet the availability and performance standards our customers expect. You will provide technical thought leadership, mentor engineers across the organization, and turn small ideas into high-fidelity technical game plans that achieve both reliability and business goals.
Reliability Engineering:
Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.
Own observability strategy across services — metrics, logs, traces, and alerting — ensuring signals are actionable and tied to user impact.
Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience/chaos testing for critical public-facing services.
Establish production readiness reviews and partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
Identify and eliminate toil through automation, self-healing systems, and improved observability.
Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems and applications to drive performance tuning and fault finding.
Contribute reliability improvements to the platform through infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes configuration, working within Cloud Platform team standards.
Incident Management & Response:
Own and evolve the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and postmortem practice.
Participate in on-call rotations and provide hands-on support during incidents with appropriate urgency.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues, driving blameless root cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.
Standards & Architecture:
Champion reliability, scalability, and security standards across AA Tech services and the AA Tech product platform.
Partner and inform strategic architecture decisions for new services and major platform changes for reliability risks (failure modes, redundancy, scaling limits, alerting) before launch as part of Cloud Platform design reviews.
Define and maintain reliability standards (e.g., SLO coverage, alerting, runbooks, backup and recovery requirements) and track how services meet them
Stay current with the latest trends in site/service reliability practices and tooling. Identify proven technologies and solutions for emerging challenges.
Technical Mentorship:
Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior-level DevOps and Software Engineers utilizing proven design patterns and experience building large-scale public-facing software.
Foster a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the engineering organization.
Provide technical thought leadership to implement strategic architecture, systems, and projects on the roadmap.
Proven track record running SLO/error budget programs and incident management for large-scale production systems.
Deep experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog) and alert design.
Working proficiency with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS; comfortable reading, reviewing, and contributing infrastructure code.
Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and tooling.

Hands-on experience using or building agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP-based integrations) to automate engineering or operational workflows, with appropriate guardrails and human oversight.

About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The National Portfolio Manager is a strategic partner to the National Lead, Oncology Nurse Educator (ONE) field team, responsible for development and support of portfolio nursing strategy and tactical plan and translating brand and portfolio strategies into effective field execution and ensuring the ONE organization has the tools, resources, processes, and cross-functional alignment needed to perform at a high level.
This role works across three hematology franchises and serves as a key connector between ONE, Brand, Sales, Field Operations, Field Force Effectiveness, Analytics, Training, Medical, and other enterprise partners. This role leads through influence in a highly matrixed environment, balancing portfolio priorities with the unique needs of each franchise while leading above brand portfolio nursing strategy  for AbbVie Oncology Hematology portfolio products and customers it serves.
This position will not have external customer responsibilities but is expected to use previous external customer experience to help maximize performance.
Key Responsibilities
Drive Portfolio Education Strategy & Execution: Translate oncology portfolio and brand priorities into clear ONE field priorities, plans, milestones, and execution requirements across three franchises.
Support and Direct Creation of Portfolio Nurse Education Strategy: Support National Director in creation of portfolio above brand nursing strategy and tactics to support HCP/nurse education of disease and therapy management before, during, and after therapy.
Lead Through Influence:  Build alignment and drive decisions across cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority; navigate competing priorities with strong judgment, credibility, and organizational savvy.
Optimize Field Operations:  Partner with Field Operations to ensure ONE has effective tools, processes, systems, reporting, training, and infrastructure to execute efficiently and compliantly.
Advocate for ONE:  Represent the voice, needs, and value of the ONE organization in cross-functional planning; build compelling business cases for appropriate resources, capabilities, and support.
Enable Field Performance:  Identify emerging field needs, barriers, and opportunities and rapidly mobilize resources and partners to address them.
Leverage Insights & Analytics:  Use field data, customer insights, and performance trends to identify opportunities, inform priorities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Lead Strategic Initiatives:  Own complex, cross-functional projects from strategy through implementation, managing priorities, dependencies, timelines, risks, and stakeholder accountability.
Strengthen Communication & Engagement:  Develop clear, compelling communications and executive presentations that create alignment, reinforce priorities, and keep the ONE and other in-field partners informed and engaged.
Advance Innovation & Technology:  Identify and implement opportunities to use technology, automation, analytics, and AI to improve ONE effectiveness, productivity, and scalability.
Ensure Operational & Compliance Excellence:  Partner with Legal, Compliance, and relevant stakeholders to ensure ONE activities, processes, and resources meet AbbVie standards and requirements. Explore benchmarking against other ONE networks to continuously evolve ways of working.
Continuously Improve:  Benchmark and evolve ONE ways of working, capabilities, and infrastructure to support a high-performing, scalable national organization.
Bachelor’s degree required; nursing, healthcare, business, or life sciences preferred.
5+ years of pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, or related industry experience; oncology/hematology strongly preferred.
Previous field leadership, sales leadership, field operations, commercial strategy, or field effectiveness experience preferred.
Clinical & Industry Expertise: Strong clinical patient management experience, oncology clinical acumen and understanding of hematology/oncology treatment, nursing practice, healthcare environments, and the pharmaceutical industry.
Strategic & Business Acumen: Ability to translate strategy into focused field execution; understand customer and account dynamics; use data and insights to prioritize resources and make sound business decisions.
Influence & Collaboration: Proven ability to influence without authority and lead effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational levels. Demonstrated track record of delivering results, building trusted relationships, and operating with an enterprise mindset.
Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and business information into clear, actionable messages.
Judgment & Agility: Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities and lead effectively through ambiguity and change.
Talent & Growth Mindset: Demonstrated commitment to developing others and continuously expanding personal and organizational capability; ability and desire to grow into broader leadership responsibilities.
Compliance & Integrity: Demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical compliance and regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain appropriate boundaries between clinical education and promotional activity.
Project Management Excellence: Strong project management, prioritization, and execution skills with a demonstrated sense of urgency. Proficiency with technology, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve business effectiveness.
Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.
Must have needed authorization and ability to drive a Company leased vehicle or rental.
Additional Requirements:
Travel: up to 30%-50%, depending on residence location.  Located in the US, preferably near a metropolitan airport.
Required to satisfy all applicable health care industry credentialing requirements to gain & maintain entry into facilities and organizations. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting & specific licenses required by states or cities.
Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​
The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.
Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.​

The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.

This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.

Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
AbbVie Immunology is expanding its early discovery Systems Immunology team in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The team is focused on identifying and evaluating new targets for the treatment of autoimmune and chronic inflammatory diseases through computational analysis of human disease tissue-derived datasets and validation using humanized experimental approaches.
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled individual to join our team as a Computational Biology Scientist. The successful candidate will develop and apply computational approaches across single-cell, bulk transcriptomic, proteomic, and other multi-omics datasets to generate insights into disease biology, identify and prioritize therapeutic targets, and support translational research.
The individual will work in a multidisciplinary team analyzing human disease datasets, including single-cell RNA-seq, CITE-seq, bulk RNA-seq, Olink proteomics, and other molecular profiling data. The candidate will collaborate with disease-area and experimental teams to translate complex biological data into actionable target and biomarker hypotheses, and will contribute to scientific presentations, internal reports, and publications.
This position will be based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a hybrid work arrangement, and requires scientific curiosity, attention to detail, hands-on computational experience, and a collaborative work style.
Key Responsibilities:
Single-Cell and Tissue Atlas Analysis
Establish and apply analysis strategies for single-cell RNA-seq and CITE-seq datasets, including quality control, integration, clustering, cell-type and cell-state annotation, and differential expression.
Build, curate, and analyze large single-cell atlases and internal patient cohorts derived from human disease tissues.
Benchmark integration and representation-learning methods, including variational autoencoders, generative models, and foundation-model approaches.
Use single-cell data to identify disease-associated cell states, pathways, biomarkers, and context-specific target biology.
Bulk RNA-seq and Olink Proteomics
Develop and execute analysis workflows for bulk RNA-seq data, including quality control, normalization, differential expression, pathway enrichment, and cross-cohort comparison.
Analyze Olink proteomics datasets to identify disease-associated proteins, biomarkers, pharmacodynamic signals, and target-related molecular signatures.
Integrate bulk RNA-seq and Olink results with single-cell and other molecular datasets to connect tissue-level signals with relevant cell types and biological pathways.
Collaborate with experimental and translational scientists to interpret transcriptomic and proteomic findings and define follow-up analyses.
Machine Learning and Quantitative Analysis
Apply statistical and machine-learning methods to high-dimensional biological datasets and evaluate model performance using fit-for-purpose validation strategies.
Use cloud and high-performance computing environments to support scalable analysis of large datasets.
Scientific Communication and Collaboration
Interpret findings and communicate scientific data, analytical limitations, and recommendations clearly to multidisciplinary internal stakeholders.
Present work to disease-area experts and collaborate closely with computational, translational, and experimental scientists.
Provide computational expertise for internal and external collaborations and contribute to conference presentations, publications, and other scientific deliverables, as appropriate.
BS or MS degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, genomics, biostatistics, computer science, or a related quantitative field, with typically 2–4 years (MS) or 5–6 years (BS) of relevant research or industry experience.
Hands-on experience processing and analyzing single-cell RNA-seq data.
Experience analyzing bulk RNA-seq data, including differential expression and functional enrichment.
Proficiency in Python and/or R and experience working in Linux-based computing environments.
Experience with commonly used bioinformatics tools and frameworks such as Scanpy, AnnData, Cell Ranger, scvi-tools, DESeq2, GSEA, WGCNA, or related methods.
Experience applying statistical or machine-learning approaches to high-dimensional biological data.
Ability to translate biological questions into analytical plans, critically interpret results, and communicate conclusions and limitations.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality analyses with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience analyzing Olink or other high-plex proteomics datasets.
Experience with CITE-seq, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, or integrative multi-omics analysis.
Experience building or benchmarking machine-learning models, including convolutional neural networks, autoencoders, generative models, transfer learning, or foundation models.
Experience with cloud or high-performance computing environments, including AWS and/or SLURM.
Familiarity with gene regulatory networks, co-expression analysis, pathway enrichment, and target-prioritization workflows.
Understanding of immunology and autoimmune or chronic inflammatory disease biology.
Experience collaborating with experimental scientists or disease-area teams to support target discovery or validation.
Evidence of scientific communication through presentations, posters, publications, technical reports, or related research contributions.

AbbVie is seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our Analytics & AI organization and help advance the next generation of Copay Intelligence capabilities.
This role will focus on developing innovative machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that help identify complex reimbursement and affordability program dynamics, improve patient access insights, and drive more proactive decision-making across patient support programs.
The successful candidate will play a key role in building predictive intelligence products that leverage healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data to identify emerging opportunities, uncover hidden patterns, and generate actionable recommendations. These capabilities support a long-term strategy to enhance copay program intelligence, improve affordability insights, and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Working closely with data engineering, business stakeholders, technology teams, and analytics partners, this individual will help transform large-scale healthcare data into scalable AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact.
What You'll Be Doing
The Senior Data Scientist will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of advanced analytics and AI solutions supporting AbbVie's Copay Intelligence initiatives. This individual will work on highly visible strategic programs focused on predictive intelligence, healthcare affordability analytics, patient access insights, and advanced machine learning applications. The role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into practical solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about solving challenging problems with data and enjoys working across the full lifecycle of AI and machine learning product development.
Core Responsibilities
AI & Machine Learning Development
Develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.
Build predictive models that identify patterns, risks, and opportunities from healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data.
Design scoring frameworks, recommendation engines, and decision-support systems that enable proactive business actions.
Evaluate and implement modern AI methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, graph analytics, and Generative AI approaches.
Continuously improve model performance through experimentation, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
Advanced Analytics
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to uncover actionable business insights.
Perform feature engineering, predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, and statistical analyses.
Assess and monitor model performance using both statistical and business outcome metrics.
Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.
AI Product Development & Operationalization
Partner with data engineering and technology teams to deploy machine learning solutions into production environments.
Design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
Implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
Support development of enterprise AI products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
Ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.
Collaboration & Leadership
Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
Serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
Present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.
Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in AI, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) is preferred but not required.
Equivalent combinations of education, specialized training, and relevant professional experience will be considered.
6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.

Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Experience building predictive, classification, forecasting, recommendation, or optimization models.
Strong knowledge of statistics, experimentation, predictive modeling, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud-based environments.
Familiarity with MLOps, model deployment, model monitoring, and production AI practices.
Experience using modern software development and version control practices.
