Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of AI technologies.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, payer, patient support, or market access data.
Experience developing AI-powered decision support systems.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, or other large-scale data environments.
Experience deploying Generative AI or Large Language Model solutions.
Experience operating in regulated industries where data quality, governance, and validation are critical.

Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a newly formed center of excellence in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences organization. Our mission is to transform how AbbVie conducts ongoing clinical trial surveillance — integrating trial data, analytics and AI so that study teams and patient safety colleagues see emerging safety and efficacy signals early, and can act on them with confidence. This is work upstream, inside ongoing clinical trials, where insight can still change decisions for the study and for patients.
The Senior Manager, Trial Surveillance & Analytics is a hands-on, full-stack data scientist who takes a surveillance question from intake to a working solution. You will work in a small team that owns a capability end to end — from the data, through the analysis, to the tool that study teams use — and you will own your solutions from problem statement to a working product that people use. The team is AI-native from day one: agentic coding and AI agents are part of how we work, with room to experiment and to scale what works. You will combine depth in one area (such as statistical programming and reporting, data integration, data visualization, data science and machine learning, or data and software engineering) with enough breadth across clinical data, analytics and AI to deliver on your own, with the support of the team. As an early member of a new center of excellence, you will help define how it works, the standards it sets and the capabilities it builds, partnering across Global Patient Safety, therapeutic area clinical development teams, Statistics, Statistical Programming and data engineering across the portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Frame surveillance problems with stakeholders before building: understand the decision to be supported, design for adoption, and iterate with users.
Design and build data pipelines and analysis-ready, integrated data on SDTM, ADaM and integrated databases to support safety and efficacy surveillance.
Lead blinded, standardized analytics across studies and compounds to detect emerging safety and efficacy signals early.
Deliver reporting — tables, listings and figures, safety reports and listings — and automate it wherever possible.
Develop applications, dashboards and self-service tools that study teams and patient safety colleagues use themselves; drive their adoption and measure their use.
Apply generative and agentic AI across the analysis workflow, build AI agents on the clinical data foundation, and measure the gain in time and quality.
Integrate clinical trial and real-world data where the science requires it, assessing comparability and data quality first.
Lead projects and small cross-functional pods; coach and mentor team members. May include indirect supervision of employees and contract staff.
Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate technical concepts and results clearly to non-technical audiences.
Ensure adherence to applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and functional quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 8+ years of experience) or PhD (with 4+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Machine learning and AI or a highly related field.
Experience may be in pharmaceutical, biotech, health technology or related industries.
Strong hands-on programming in R and Python, plus SQL and version control (e.g. Git), with a track record of writing production-quality code for end-to-end analytical pipelines.
Demonstrated experience applying generative or agentic AI to analytical or programming work, with measurable results.
Experience working with clinical trial data (e.g. CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and/or real-world data (e.g. EHR, claims, registries).
A track record of building analytical tools or solutions that were adopted and sustained by their users.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts in plain language and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing and building agentic AI systems (e.g. multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval and evaluation), with a track record of solutions delivered and used in production.
Experience in clinical development, drug safety, pharmacovigilance, clinical trial monitoring or regulatory evidence generation.
Knowledge of clinical trial design and of methods for real-world evidence, such as cohort definition, confounding control and external comparators.
Experience building interactive visualizations and data apps with modern frameworks (e.g. Plotly / Dash, Streamlit, Shiny, React / D3) and deploying on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS).
Familiarity with SAS.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives; formal business or leadership training is a plus.
Publications, presentations or community leadership in data science, statistics or AI.

The Biologics CMC Development organization at AbbVie has a long and rich history of biologics development, leveraging comprehensive end-to-end CMC capabilities to advance complex biologic therapies, such as bi-specifics and novel modalities, from discovery through human clinical studies and eventual licensure.
The Cell Line Development (CLD) Innovation Group is seeking a Senior Scientist I to join a talented and collaborative team developing next-generation CHO cell line platforms for the production of recombinant antibodies and complex biologics. This is a hands-on, laboratory-focused role for a versatile molecular biologist who will independently drive expression-optimization projects across both the vector and the host cell — from experimental design through execution and data interpretation. The successful candidate will design and test vector constructs, engineer host cells, conduct transfection and clone-generation campaigns in CHO cells, and apply a deep theoretical understanding of recombinant protein expression to improve titer in stable cell lines. This is not a single-technique position: the role spans the full set of levers that govern expression, and the candidate is expected to think, read, and propose, then carry the work out at the bench with a high degree of independence.
Responsibilities:
Independently conceive ideas and designs to investigate CHO expression technical improvements across both vector and host cell.
Design and test dozens of vector constructs in recombinant stable CHO cell lines for increased mAb titer. Rapidly execute the associated transfections, screening, and clone-characterization studies to generate decision-quality data.
Employ a variety of hands-on laboratory techniques, including transfection, aseptic CHO cell culture, DNA gene copy number analysis, RNA expression analysis (ddPCR / RT-qPCR), mAb titer measurement, cell engineering to knock in/out target genes.
Operate and interpret data from core CLD instrumentation, including Octet (BLI titer), ViCell, CloneSelect Imager, microfluidic clone-screening platforms such as the Beacon, flow cytometry. Share responsibility for equipment maintenance.
Apply a rigorous theoretical and practical understanding of recombinant protein expression from the genome to the protein — including genomic loci, epigenetics, transcription, mRNA stability, translation, the organelles and secretory machinery involved, and the engineering constraints specific to industrial CHO cell line development.
Author and co-author cell line development technical reports and present data to the group and to leadership; contribute scientific insight to project teams.
Collaborate closely with cell culture, analytical, purification, and bioinformatics colleagues to meet project timelines, and adhere to corporate standards for code of conduct, safety, materials handling, and good documentation practices.
Required:
Senior Scientist I:  BS with a minimum of 10 years, or MS with a minimum of 8 years of experience is strongly preferred , or PhD with no minimum years’ experience, in molecular biology, cell biology, biochemistry, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated ability to read the literature, review external sources, and gather inputs to synthesize technically sound ideas and design proper experimental controls.
Demonstrated ability to independently analyze experimental data, draw appropriate conclusions, and communicate them to a wide audience.
Demonstrated proficiency with designing and implementing vector improvements to increase recombinant antibody expression levels in stable CHO cells.
Proficiency with Geneious Prime or similar software for designing and annotating DNA vectors, primers, and probes, and performing sequence alignments.
Proficiency with most or all of the following techniques and instrumentation: transfection, aseptic mammalian cell culture, Octet, ViCell, CloneSelect Imager, and microfluidic clone-screening platforms such as the Beacon.
Demonstrated ability to learn, understand, and master new experimental techniques, and to multi-task and work within timelines.
Strong scientific communication skills — verbal, written, and data presentation — with detailed daily digital lab notebook record-keeping proficiency.
A candidate who combines hands-on wet-lab depth with the ability to think alongside the team and then execute independently.
Preferred:

The AbbVie Immunology Discovery Pathology group is at the forefront of AI-driven digital pathology, developing quantitative and translational pathology approaches to support target validation, deepen our understanding of disease biology, and advance drug discovery.
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Image Analysis Scientist with expertise spanning digital pathology, computer vision, machine learning, and scientific programming, combined with a strong foundation in immunology and tissue biology.
Our group generates quantitative insights from H&E and immunolabeled tissue sections and applies emerging spatial transcriptomics and high-plex spatial proteomics technologies to investigate cellular phenotypes, tissue organization, and spatial relationships within the tissue microenvironment.
The successful candidate will independently lead the development and application of advanced computer vision and machine-learning approaches for histopathology image analysis, including deep learning and representation learning. The candidate will also develop robust computational workflows for high-dimensional image-based spatial protein datasets, including approaches to identify and quantify cell populations, characterize cellular phenotypes, and analyze spatial relationships and tissue organization.
This individual will be part of a highly collaborative, multidisciplinary team and will work closely with pathologists, computational biologists, immunologists, and discovery scientists across the organization. The successful candidate will combine computational innovation with biological insight to develop and apply digital pathology approaches that address important scientific questions and help drive innovative drug discovery research.
Responsibilities
Independently design, develop, optimize, and validate advanced machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision approaches for digital pathology, including cell and tissue segmentation, classification, feature extraction, and representation learning, to identify and quantify histopathologic features, cellular phenotypes, and spatial relationships.
Develop and deploy robust image analysis workflows for high-dimensional, multiplexed imaging datasets to quantify cell populations and phenotypes and characterize spatial relationships and tissue organization.
Apply appropriate statistical methods and rigorous model validation strategies to assess model performance and generalizability, including held-out test datasets and quantitative performance metrics such as IoU and F1 score.
Develop computational workflows to integrate and analyze data across multiple imaging and spatial modalities , including H&E, multiplex immunofluorescence, spatial proteomics, and spatial transcriptomics.
Develop Python-based tools and scripts to automate image and data-processing workflows and address interoperability challenges across imaging platforms, analysis tools, and data formats.
Partner closely with pathologists and discovery scientists to perform rigorous quality control, interpret image analysis outputs, and ensure that quantitative results are biologically meaningful.
Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to troubleshoot complex image and data analysis challenges and deliver high-quality results within established timelines.
Serve as a subject matter expert in computational digital pathology , providing scientific and technical guidance on image analysis strategies, methodologies, and applications across multidisciplinary project teams.
Stay current with emerging advances in AI, computer vision, and computational pathology, and evaluate and implement new methodologies that can enhance pathology-driven drug discovery.
Communicate analytical strategies , methodologies, and results clearly and effectively to scientific and cross-functional stakeholders through written and oral presentations.
Maintain accurate and reproducible documentation of analytical workflows, algorithms, and results in electronic laboratory notebooks and project reports.
Work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams to advance project objectives and deliver high-quality scientific results.
PhD in computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, biomedical image analysis, or related quantitative discipline, with 4+ years of relevant applied experience.
Strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, image processing, computer vision, and machine learning, with demonstrated experience developing computational methods and algorithms for quantitative image analysis.
Demonstrated expertise in developing, optimizing, and validating image analysis and machine-learning approaches to extract quantitative features from H&E, immunohistochemistry, and/or multiplexed tissue imaging datasets.
Strong proficiency in Python for scientific computing, image analysis, and machine learning, with experience using relevant libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar. Experience with R is desirable.
Experience analyzing high-dimensional multiplexed imaging datasets, such as multiplex immunofluorescence, or imaging mass cytometry (IMC), including cell segmentation, cell phenotyping, feature extraction, and spatial analysis.
Experience developing reproducible and well-documented computational workflows, including version-controlled code, structured data organization, and appropriate documentation of analytical methods and parameters.
Experience with digital pathology image analysis platforms, such as Visiopharm and QuPath, with the ability to develop customized computational approaches when existing tools do not adequately address the scientific question.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams and communicate complex computational concepts to scientific collaborators from diverse backgrounds.

Strong background in immunology and tissue biology, or demonstrated experience applying computational image analysis to immunologic diseases. Experience with rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease, or related inflammatory conditions is particularly desirable.
Strong understanding of spatial omics technologies and molecular pathology techniques, including immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, in situ hybridization, and related tissue-based assays.
Experience integrating and analyzing multimodal spatial datasets, including combinations of histopathology, spatial proteomics, and spatial transcriptomics.
Experience with contemporary computational pathology approaches, including deep learning, representation learning, or related AI-based methods for extracting biologically meaningful information from tissue images.
Familiarity with cloud-based and/or high-performance computing environments, including AWS or similar computing infrastructure.

Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning and innovation, with an openness to new ideas, methodologies, and technologies and the ability to translate innovative approaches into practical scientific solutions.

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. The Strategic Account Manager (SAM) is responsible for representing the SkinMedica, DiamondGlow and Latisse brands and promote the product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. The focus will be on direct selling of products (physician dispensed skincare and skin resurfacing system) and executing pull through programs/events to patients. The SAM provides technical product and procedure expertise, as well as, competitive product differentiation. The Opportunity
At Adobe, our mission is to empower creatives, marketers, and IT professionals with application-based products that transform their daily work and accelerate progress towards their business goals. Our Technical Pre-Sales (TPS) organization plays a critical role in preparing customers to purchase Adobe’s integrated solutions by understanding their business needs, defining and validating their technical requirements, and demonstrating their ideal future state with Adobe technology.
The Enterprise Architecture (EA) team is within the TPS group. This role will be supporting the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team within TPS.
Learn More about Enterprise Architecture
Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture team sits within the TPS organization and works directly with Adobe customers to understand their current technology architecture and usage, evaluate its effectiveness as it relates to their larger business objectives, and create a future-state technology architecture to best support their long-term marketing vision.
You will learn how the team runs, how they interact with customers, real-world customer problems mapped to Adobe software solutions, and what key results they are responsible for building all while supporting and influencing the growing team’s operational strategy.
What You’ll Do
Learn to connect the dots between customers’ business problems and Adobe’s solution offerings to demonstrate value for our customers and their business
Collaborate with cross-organizational partners including sales teams, solution experts, digital strategists, customer success managers, and more to develop innovative solutions to help them through various stages in the sales cycle
Gain experience with conducting current-state technology analyses and developing high-impact recommendations for future-state technology
Learn to build custom architecture diagrams and phased implementations that showcase how Adobe technology can best support our customers’ objectives
Create presentations to best communicate technical information and architecture mapping to our customers’ business needs
Leverage Agentic AI technologies to enhance our current offerings and help to design the future for our customers’ evolving digital landscapes
Help brands fully capitalize on the era of digital & agentic transformation, so they can deliver personalized and meaningful experiences across all devices and channels for their customers by aligning to Adobe Customer Experience Orchestration solutions.
What You Need to Succeed
Currently enrolled full time and pursuing a Bachelor's degree graduating between December 2026 and June 2027
Proven interest in business strategy, digital marketing, technology, analytics or experience design through coursework, extracurricular activities, or work/internship experience
Curiosity and/or application across agentic AI technologies, including agents, LLMs and AI tooling
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills including conducting research, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations
Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
Ability to communicate complex ideas optimally both verbally and in writing; ability to deliver compelling customer presentations communicating technical concepts
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Passion for new knowledge, resourceful and able to absorb concepts quickly
You enjoy challenges and learning about industry and technology trends
You bring a positive, can-do attitude to your work
About Adobe
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

title: Core Agent Engineer
location: San Francisco; San Jose; Seattle; New York
description:
Job Description
The Opportunity
Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices.
This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time.
What you'll do
Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web.
Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience.
Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure.
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process.
Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment.
Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them.
Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve.
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding.
Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale.
Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering.
What you'll need to succeed
Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production.
Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier.
Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms.
Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows.
Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products.
Familiarity with the quality, trust, and reliability requirements of shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience, including responsible AI considerations specific to generative and agentic systems.

Adobe’s Legal and Government Relations (LGR) team partners with business and functional teams to manage the company's legal and government affairs. description:
The Opportunity
The Executive Protection Officer (EPO) / Global Security Specialist will join Adobe’s growing Global Safety and Security (GSS) Executive Protection (EP) program and work in the areas of Executive Close Protection, Travel Security, Residential Security, Protective Intelligence, along with other EP assignments and activities. The person in this role will report to the Director of Executive Protection. They will belong to a team that safeguards Adobe’s Executive Team (E-team) and other senior leaders! This includes VIPs visiting Adobe facilities or attending Adobe-sponsored events. The incumbent will also support other GSS programs such as Investigations, Major Event Security and Crisis Preparedness / Business Continuity Planning. The incumbent is encouraged to demonstrate Adobe Values and handle the position’s duties with discretion, nuance, and maturity. They need excellent judgement, decision-making, and program management skills.
What you'll Do
Contribute to the expansion of Adobe’s Global EP program which includes Close Protection Operations, Travel Security, Residential Security, and Threat Monitoring. Coordinate contract team members and work in close partnership with Adobe's E-team, their immediate staff, and family members.
Establish and maintain trust-focused professional relationships with the Adobe leadership team and key partners.
Continuously improve global law enforcement and security liaison efforts with government and private sector contacts to address crime, political unrest, terrorism and violent individual with grievances.
Contribute to continuous training and professional development for EP personnel and contracted staff, implementing programs on situational awareness, surveillance detection, digital security, and emerging protective technologies to ensure preparedness for evolving and emerging threats.
Review key performance indicators, including response times and risk mitigation success, seek feedback from executives, partners and provide recommendations for improvements.
Contribute to regular program reviews, continuously assess and improve EP program’s strategies, protocols, and operational efficiency.
What you need to succeed
Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of experience in protective services at the operational and leadership level (senior supervisory experience preferred).
Extensive practical experience in protective operations (site advances, route planning, protective intelligence, security vehicle operations, etc.) across both local and international settings. Experience in high-risk locations a plus.
Extensive Dignitary/Executive Protection training in both soft skills (assessment, planning, mentality, conflict resolution, diplomatic negotiations, etc.) and hard skills (protective formations, motorcade operations, counter-terrorism driving, evacuation to safety, threat detection and mitigation, etc.)
Ability to walk long distances and remain alert and focused for extended periods of time per executive’s schedule and activity!
Demonstrated effectiveness leading a team of security contractors. Skilled at facility / residential security technology deployment and management.
Established track record managing foreign security teams in non-English speaking, and multicultural environments strongly preferred (foreign language ability desired).
Proven capability to collaborate with security and law enforcement partners at all levels, jurisdictions and global locations. Ability to leverage networks / connections and diplomatically engage and develop new support networks in unfamiliar or foreign environments.
Effective and appropriate communication with exec and staff and family. Demonstrated ability to brief senior leaders with credibility and confidence. Outstanding people skills, negotiation skills, and ability to work well with others outside of the security or law enforcement profession.
Demonstrated outstanding judgement and decision-making during crisis situations involving life-safety matters. Additional training, certifications and life-saving skills preferred.
Professional training and extensive experience in investigation, major event security, crisis preparedness and business continuity planning.
Professional training and expertise in surveillance detection and counter-surveillance in domestic and overseas environments preferred.
Willingness to relocate and live in the area around corporate headquarters in San Jose. Available for worldwide travel at times on short notice. Ability to expertly navigate international travel, international borders, ports of entry, Embassies and Consulates for traveling teams and Adobe executives.
Trustworthy in handling confidential information. Demonstrated discretion and skilled in protection of sensitive proprietary and personal information. Active or prior U.S. Government security clearance preferred.

title: Sr. Manager Risk & Controls
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking an experienced risk and controls leader to join the Chief Accounting Office as Senior Manager, Risk & Controls. This role offers high visibility at the crossroads of finance transformation, technology, and compliance. As the embedded risk advisor to the Finance & Tech Transformation Office (FTTO), you will collaborate directly with teams driving product launches, process automation, system implementations, and large-scale business transformation initiatives. Your focus will be ensuring that robust controls are built into solutions from the beginning, enabling innovation to move quickly without introducing compliance risks later.
You will have a meaningful role helping the organization coordinate a growing portfolio of optimization products and transformation programs. You will ensure alignment with SOX, ITAC, and ITGC requirements and support business objectives. This position works closely with internal and external auditors to maintain audit readiness, manage evidence, and lead timely remediation of control gaps across the transformation portfolio.
In this position, you can help guide Adobe’s finance operations as they scale and transform, while developing a risk and controls framework that fosters growth and innovation.
What you'll Do
Risk & Controls for Improvement Products
Partner with Process Optimization product owners to identify control risk (financial reporting, ITGC, access, data integrity) introduced by new automations, RPA bots, or process redesigns before they become available
Design and validate control frameworks for optimization products, while maintaining compliance with SOX and audit requirements
Develop and maintain a comprehensive risk register,control inventory and governance framework across the optimization product portfolio
Act as the expert authority on financial reporting risks, IT Application Controls (ITACs), and IT General Controls (ITGCs for initiatives across the CAO organization
SOX Compliance & Audit Readiness
Act as the main point of contact for SOX-IT and ITGC audit inquiries related to transformation, automation and optimization initiatives
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure controls are designed, documented, tested, and operating effectively
Coordinate updates to key financial reporting documentation, including SOX Prioritization, Risk and Control Matrix, Process Flowcharts, and Report Populations
Maintain documentation standards so that control build decisions are defensible and traceable
Build and Scale the Risk & Controls Function
Establish and grow a high-performing Risk & Controls team supporting Adobe's expanding transformation and optimization portfolio.
Define the operating model, processes, tools, and governance required to scale risk coverage as the portfolio grows.
Recruit, develop, and mentor team members, creating clear development paths and a strong culture of accountability and partnership.
Program & Collaborator Management
Manage a portfolio of risk/controls workstreams while multiple optimization and transformation activities take place.
Define and track important metrics for control health, audit findings, and remediation timelines.
Build strong relationships across Finance, Technology, Internal Audit, and Transformation teams to drive a proactive risk management mindset.
Develop and communicate knowledge through written correspondence and verbal presentations.
Document, coordinate, and close open requests from a variety of sources to ensure timely completion.
What you need to succeed
Required
7+ years in risk & controls, SOX/ITGC compliance, internal audit, or GRC program management, ideally with exposure to both finance and technology domains.
Public accounting firm experience with SOX, audit, or internal audit functions.
Direct, hands-on experience applying ITAC (IT Application Controls) and ITGC (IT General Controls) frameworks, including designing, testing, and remediating controls in live environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding controls into system implementations, RPA/automation programs, or large-scale transformation projects (not just post-facto auditing).
Deep understanding of SOX 404 requirements, audit methodology, and the full audit lifecycle including Test of Build and Test of Efficiency.
Strong collaborator management skills; able to influence without direct authority within Finance, IT, and business teams.
Prior people management experience or demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Preferred

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
When a significant severe safety incident impacts, or threatens to impact, our community or company, the Community Crisis Management (CCM) team works to coordinate a swift and effective response across the company to mitigate any continued damage. The team is responsible and accountable for immediate decisions, managing the cross-functional response to severe safety crises on the platform, keeping Airbnb leadership properly informed and involved, and for alerting relevant team leaders to any root causes or vulnerabilities that may have been uncovered throughout the response.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Community Crisis Investigator, you carry your own caseload and run the day-to-day response, with a defined check-in point for the calls that set precedent or carry external exposure. You assess incidents and bring what you learn back to the team.
A Typical Day:
Crisis Case Work
Assess incoming incidents and recommend whether a case meets the threshold for crisis implementation, drafting summaries concise and comprehensive enough that the decision-maker can act on them without sending them back.
Outline and drive the case management actions needed for stakeholders to respond effectively, keeping the response moving inside the incident’s timeline.
Research case precedent and consult stakeholders when a case does not fit an established pattern, and bring your recommended option with its reasoning rather than an open question.
Prepare concise overviews and next steps for urgent, monitoring, or implemented cases, and note team updates or housekeeping items during regional check-ins.
Communication and Stakeholder Management
Draft crisis case communication for senior stakeholders, and supply the case detail and assessment that executive notifications are built from.
Keep stakeholders and GCM (Global Crisis Management) leadership current on case status proactively, before they ask.
Hold day-to-day communication with your assigned cross-functional partners: maintain regular contact, come prepared to the agenda, and bring what you learn back to the global GCM team.
Systemic Improvement
Flag where policy, product, or process failed the community member, with enough specificity that the owning team can act. The goal is closing the gap that allowed the incident, not only resolving the incident.
Keep the case management tool accurate for your own cases and raise data or backlog problems you notice, so the team’s view of the global caseload stays trustworthy.
Team Contribution
Review peers’ assessments as a second pair of eyes before submission, checking for errors, missing stakeholders, and recommendations worth adding.
Share what you learn from your cases and stakeholder relationships with the team.
Contribute to team culture and to a working environment where people can do this work sustainably.
Operational Rigor
Maintain case documentation and trackers to a standard that supports accurate analytics and clean handoffs within and across regions.
Complete work within the dedicated SLAs, and raise it early when a case is at risk of slipping rather than after it has.
Your Expertise:
6+ years of experience in customer support or front-line work handling escalated, sensitive cases, including crisis or survivor-facing work such as a crisis line, victim advocacy, emergency response, or trust and safety.
Proven track record of working collaboratively with multi-functional leads in a matrixed organization.
Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to stay focused with a calm demeanor in stressful situations.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Airbnb Payments team allows any two people in the world to frictionlessly exchange money with easy to use payments services. It is a core strategy to fulfill Airbnb’s belongs anywhere mission.We are building a world-class payments platform that moves billions of dollars, in 191 countries, with 75 currencies, through a complex ecosystem of payments partners. We build and maintain our own in-house global payments platform because no solution exists with the global reach needed. As the platform grows we’ll be adding new payment partners, global licenses, compliance and regulation controls, and building new payment experiences for our guests and hosts.
The Difference You Will Make:
We are looking for talented and self-motivated Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working in this highly dynamic domain and collaborating with world-class XFN teams to advance our mission. As part of the Payments Risk Engineering team, you will be in charge of designing and building a wide range of scalable systems and robust infrastructure to detect, mitigate and resolve risk issues across our entire payments platform, and to protect our communities and businesses from all malicious activities and fraudulent actors. You will be deeply involved in the technical details of building highly available and real-time risk services in close collaboration with product, data science and operations teams to understand and react to the ever evolving risk scenarios and to make Airbnb the world’s safest while easiest to use payments platform.
A Typical Day:
Building and maintaining a long-term technology stack with well defined APIs that is service-oriented, modular, granular, observable, and efficient.
Working closely with data scientists, product managers and other XFN partners to build business insights, develop product features and respond to fraud attacks and risk issues across the platform.
Building and maintaining integrations with third party vendors / payments networks & processors to empower our in house risk systems.
Developing and iterating on our risk detection, mitigation and resolution strategies as risk scenarios/business requirements evolve.
Focusing on continuous monitoring and alerting to uplevel the quality and observability of our risk systems.
Collaborating with other engineering teams across Airbnb to advance our engineering process and technical foundation.
Your Expertise:
5+ years of relevant industry experience (Payments/Fintech) as a backend software engineer.
Proficient in at least one major programming language (preferably Java/Kotlin/Python). Experience in React (or any equivalent JS library) would be nice to have.
Exposure to architectural patterns of large, high-scale web applications, such as well-designed APIs, high volume data pipelines, and efficient algorithms.
Passion for delivering products end-to-end, from ideation through planning and scoping to implementation and experimental A/B testing.
Rigor in high code quality, automated testing, and other engineering best practices.
Experience or desire to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams with product, data scientists, design and operations.
Familiarity with experimentation and machine learning techniques
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills and detail oriented.
Capable of making data driven decisions and articulating tradeoffs in any technical decisions.
Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience.
Experience in fraud/spam detection/mitigation in the payments domain is a huge plus, but not required.

title: ADC Engineer, Identity
description:
Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business. We are building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world and need world class people to help us implement and operate them.
We provide organizations with building block web services that allow them to innovate faster and operate their software more cost-effectively. These services-in-the-cloud include on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, querying of structured data, message queuing, and more.
The AWS Identity & Access team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing security that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed security systems involving identity management, federation, web services security, single sign-on, and much more. We enable our customers to control some of the most sensitive secrets on the Internet.
A successful ADCE Engineer does much more than plug computers together and track changes. They are instrumental in deploying, operating, and scaling a massive always-on distributed system that is core to all of AWS. We are looking for a experienced and motivated engineer to join our fast-moving and passionate team.
This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.
About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Basic qualifications: - Associate's degree or above, or Cloud+ or GICSP (Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional) or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or SSCP (Systems Security Certified Practitioner)
- 3+ years Linux systems administration experience
- 3+ years technical troubleshooting / support experience
- 2+ years of networking experience (TCP/IP)
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph
Preferred qualifications: - Comptia Security+

title: Applied Scientist, AVM Builder Enablement
description:
Applied Scientists on the AWS Vulnerability Management (AVM) Builder Enablement team use program analysis, machine learning and generative AI for managing vulnerabilities and securing the software supply chain across AWS. Our scope covers the third-party open-source packages, language ecosystems, operating systems and kernels that AWS services are built on. Our goal is to take builders out of the remediation loop. When a vulnerability is disclosed or a package is compromised, our systems work out whether it actually affects AWS, generate the fix, check that it's safe and ship it at AWS scale, with one click or no clicks at all.
New vulnerabilities are disclosed every day in the software AWS depends on, and finding and fixing them by hand doesn't scale. We build systems that detect vulnerabilities and work out whether the vulnerable code can actually be reached and exploited in a given service. They rank issues by real risk rather than raw severity scores, then fix them automatically. That can mean upgrading dependencies across ecosystems like Java, Python, JavaScript, Go and Rust, fixing breaking API changes, backporting patches, or patching operating systems and kernels across the fleet. Just as important, we check that each fix is correct and safe, so it can merge with little or no human review.
Beyond known vulnerabilities, we protect the integrity of the software supply chain itself. Modern software is assembled more than it is written, and every dependency is a potential way in for attackers. Securing it means knowing what's in our software, where it came from and whether it can be trusted. Our work here includes building and analyzing software bills of materials (SBOMs), verifying package provenance and build integrity, and detecting malicious or compromised packages before they reach production.
Our methods range from static and dynamic program analysis to LLM-based agents for code repair and upgrades. This is a chance to shape a fast-growing area that directly affects the security of AWS and its customers. You'll apply your technical depth in a fast-moving environment, and your work will reach thousands of AWS builders and services.
Key job responsibilities
• Design and build scientific approaches to vulnerability management. This includes vulnerability detection, reachability and exploitability analysis, dependency resolution, and prioritizing risk across third-party packages, operating systems and kernels.
• Build program analysis techniques (static analysis, dataflow and call-graph analysis, binary and source analysis) that tell us precisely whether a vulnerability affects a given service or host.
• Apply generative AI and agentic coding methods to fix vulnerabilities automatically. Examples include upgrading dependencies, fixing breaking API changes, backporting patches and migrating code across language versions.
• Develop ways to check that automated fixes are correct and safe, such as test generation, behavior-equivalence checking, build and runtime checks, and confidence scoring, so changes can merge with little or no human review.
• Own the design, experiments and delivery of well-defined science problems from start to finish. Turn ambiguous problems into measurable experiments and deliver solutions with measurable impact, such as faster time to fix, higher fix success rates and fewer false positives.
• Work with engineers to turn research prototypes into production systems that run reliably across AWS's codebases and fleet.

• Stay current with research in software security, program analysis, and ML for code. Contribute to internal and external publications where appropriate.
• Share your knowledge through design reviews, documentation and mentoring of junior scientists and engineers.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:
-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems
Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment
Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
U.S Citizenship Required
Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.
The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.
A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.
About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
#DCCD_AMER
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience developing and executing test procedures for mechanical or electrical systems/components based on design intent and approved equipment submittals
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of relevant discipline work experience
Preferred qualifications: - Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
- Knowledge of both mechanical and electrical equipment or design related to data center electrical and mechanical topology
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Strong communication skills, detail oriented, highly organized, and able to work in high stress environments to maintain calm and respectful interaction with multiple teams

title: Electrical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering, Data Center Design Engineering
description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud and ML/AI models running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the best possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.
Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.
If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.
We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.
At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.
Amazon has a global presence. As this position is based out of Virginia, travel to our head office in Seattle will be required. Travel should be up to 20% of your time, majority throughout the Virginia-based data centers and in-person collaboration efforts not in your assigned office location. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel will be necessary. Support could consist of working on international teams and could require developing schematic and design document packages. An understanding of international electrical design requirements is helpful but not necessary.
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities of the Electrical Engineer, will be:
Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
Review and approval of equipment submittals.
Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.
About the team
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud
platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster
a culture of inclusion that empower us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer.
That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing
resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
We are looking for a hands-on Test Engineer to join the CommSys team within AMZ Leo RF/Modem Dev, responsible for validating 3GPP- and O-RAN-compliant network elements (RAN HW/SW) across lab and integration environments. Key job responsibilities
Standards & Test Expertise
•Maintain strong working knowledge of 3GPP standards (LTE/5G NR) and the O-RAN stack (O-DU, O-CU, O-RU, fronthaul/midhaul interfaces, Open Fronthaul specifications).
•Stay current with conformance test specifications/lists (e.g., 3GPP TS 38.141/36.141 series, O-RAN conformance and interoperability test plans) and translate them into executable test cases.
•Understand RF, protocol stack layers (PHY/MAC/RLC/PDCP/RRC), and call-flow behavior well enough to interpret test results and identify root causes.
•Design new test cases to extend coverage for emerging 3GPP/O-RAN features, conformance requirements, and product-specific scenarios.
RF & Test Equipment

•Be familiar with debug and diagnostic tools such as QXDM and other over-the-air (OTA) log analysis tools to troubleshoot UE and network behavior.
Test Execution & Data Analysis
•Plan and execute test cases on lab setups covering functional, performance, conformance, and regression testing.
•Collect, organize, and analyze test data/logs (e.g., protocol traces, KPIs, OTA logs) to assess pass/fail criteria.

•Produce clear, well-documented test reports and defect write-ups for engineering and stakeholders.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
•Work closely with Hardware, Software, Integration, and Automation teams to coordinate test schedules, align on test setup requirements, and resolve blocking issues quickly.
•Support the integration team in bringing up new HW and SW builds on the test bench, including initial sanity checks and bring-up validation.
•Act as a liaison between test findings and development teams, providing actionable feedback to accelerate fixes.
Lab & Test Setup Ownership
•Build, configure, and maintain new lab test setups, including equipment racking, cabling, network configuration, and tool installation.
•Continuously improve existing setups for reliability, repeatability, and test coverage.
•Perform HW and SW upgrades/updates on test equipment and devices under test (DUTs), ensuring minimal downtime.
•Debug and resolve lab/setup-level issues (connectivity, equipment faults, synchronization, environment instability) to keep test lines operational.
•Maintain accurate setup documentation/inventory (topology diagrams, equipment lists, firmware/software versions).
Scripting & Automation
•Develop and maintain scripts (Python, Shell, TCL, or similar) to automate repetitive test procedures and setup configuration tasks.
•Build or extend automated test frameworks to increase test throughput and reduce manual effort.
•Integrate automated tests into CI/CD or regression pipelines where applicable, and maintain test automation health.

- Solid understanding of 3GPP (LTE/5G NR) architecture and O-RAN network architecture and interfaces.
- Experience with lab test equipment such as UE simulators, core network emulators, channel emulators, signal generators/analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
- Experience with debug/diagnostic tools such as QXDM for OTA log analysis.
- Experience with scripting/automation (Python strongly preferred; familiarity with pytest, Robot Framework, or similar is a plus).
- Strong debugging skills across HW, SW, and network layers.

title: Open Source Developer Advocate, Apache Iceberg, Open Source Strategy & Marketing
description:
We are looking for an Open Source Developer Advocate to be AWS’s presence in the Iceberg community: a credible, hands-on technical voice who earns trust through contribution and turns that trust into influence. You will be the two-way bridge, representing AWS to the Iceberg community while channeling community signal, ecosystem context, and customer needs back to our engineering, product, and marketing teams.
This is a role for someone who wants to build community standing that matters. Your work will lay the foundation for AWS engineers to participate more actively in the project and to be recognized as a genuine leader in one of the most important open source projects in modern data infrastructure.
Key job responsibilities
Represent AWS in the community. Be an active, opinionated participant in Iceberg community channels, mailing lists, and core specification discussions. Build the credibility and relationships needed to influence how the project evolves.
Build contributor credibility. Participate in the project, shepherd work through the community review process, and build toward committer and PMC recognition.
Create content and evangelize. Publish blogs, tutorials, and samples, and show up at the Iceberg Summit, meetups, and conferences with hands-on talks and workshops that demonstrate AWS’s Iceberg leadership.
Amplify releases and milestones. Partner with engineering and DevRel to turn changelogs, spec progress, and feature launches (for example V3 support, multi-table transactions, and performant merge-on-read) into launch stories across community and social channels.
Grow ecosystem partnerships. Build collaborative relationships with friendly partners and vendors (for example Snowflake and Netflix) to proactively help move the project forward and to strengthen AWS’s collective voice in governance.
Be the community’s voice inside AWS. Bring developer pain points, specification direction, and ecosystem opportunities into AWS roadmap conversations. Partner with product marketing to keep positioning grounded in how developers actually talk about Iceberg.
Set the strategy. Define community health and influence metrics (committers earned, PRs merged, specification working groups joined, community relationships built) and evolve the playbook as AWS’s standing in the project grows.
About the team
About the Team
The Open Source Strategy and Marketing (OSSM) team includes veterans from top open source companies and foundations alongside passionate newcomers. We help AWS service teams effectively engage with open source communities, media, analysts, and customers—increasing the scope of our open source involvement and helping people understand why it matters.
How You'll Work
You'll own the community function for Kiro Crew: setting direction, bringing proposals, not waiting for assignments. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and product marketing: leaning on them for technical depth and roadmap context, while bringing them community signal, ecosystem context, and amplification. You'll also coordinate with developer advocacy on events, content, and partner work.
Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.
Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.
