title: Sr. Product Designer, AWS Billing
description:
Every AWS customer, from a solo developer to a Fortune 100 finance team, eventually asks the same questions. What am I spending? Why am I spending it? What should I do about it? AWS Billing answers those questions for millions of customers, inside a business running at a $169 billion annualized revenue run rate.
That job is changing as AI agents are starting to act on customers' behalf. They forecast spend, recommend commitments, flag anomalies, and increasingly take action on customer’s behalf. When an agent touches someone's money, the design questions get harder: What is it allowed to do on its own? How does it explain itself? How does the customer stay in control and undo what it did? Few products anywhere face these questions at this scale or with these stakes.
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help answer them. You'll define how customers and AI agents work together to understand, forecast, and control cloud spend, and you'll set the patterns other teams build on.
- Design for trust where it matters most. Billing is where customers decide whether to trust AWS with their money, and where AI has to earn that trust.
- Define agentic UX, not just screens. Shape what agents do on a customer's behalf, where humans approve, and how automated actions stay transparent and reversible.
- Work with a wide range of customers and rich data. Design for developers, FinOps practitioners, CFOs, and channel partners, using some of the richest usage and spend data at AWS.
- Ship as an embedded partner. Work alongside product, engineering, and data science from problem framing through post-launch iteration.
Key job responsibilities
- Frame ambiguous problems before solving them. Drive clarity when requirements, customers, and feasibility are undefined.
- Define how AI agents act on customers' behalf: what they do autonomously, where humans approve, and how customers take control back.
- Design trust patterns that surface an agent's confidence, reasoning, and attribution, so customers understand why it acts.
- Design human-in-the-loop, approval, and undo patterns for actions that move money.
- Create coherent experiences across conversational, agent-driven, and console interfaces.
- Lead design from problem framing through launch, then use data signals to improve what ships.
- Partner early with data science, legal, and policy as co-designers on AI features with financial or compliance complexity.
- Establish patterns and standards that become how the team operates. Mentor other designers.
- Write narratives and strategy documents that move decisions forward, and present them to senior leadership.
A day in the life
Your morning starts with usage data from an anomaly-alert flow you shipped last month. Then you meet your PM and engineering lead to frame a new problem: when should an agent pause spend without asking? You prototype two directions with AI tools and bring them to critique. After lunch, you work with data science and legal on how an agent explains a commitment recommendation. You end the day refining a narrative for leadership review. Your customers range from solo builders to CFOs. Your work decides whether they trust an agent with their money.
About the team
AWS Billing sits at the intersection of trust and scale. Every customer, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 100 enterprise, relies on us to make spending transparent and controllable. We are a tight-knit design group within the larger AWS Design organization. We work with product, engineering, and data science. We move fast without lowering the craft bar. We are designing agents that can spot a cost spike and help stop it before the bill arrives. We believe billing should not just work. It should build confidence. If hard problems and high ownership energize you, you'll fit right in.

- Have an online portfolio or samples of work on resume, demonstrating experience creating great end-to-end, user-centered design solutions and patterns, across desktop and mobile devices
- Experience using AI tools in your design workflow, such as AI-assisted prototyping, code generation, or research synthesis
- Experience designing complex, data-dense workflows and information architecture
Preferred qualifications: - Experience designing AI-powered or agentic experiences, including delegation, trust, and human-in-the-loop patterns

title: Strategic Account Manager, US Global Selling Team
description:
We are seeking a candidate with a passion for e-commerce and a desire to make a real impact on global customers in a Day One business. Our mission is to expand selection from US-based retailers and brand owners worldwide. Although we are already a multi-billion-dollar business, we believe we are just getting started, as less than 5% of US-based sellers have started their international journey. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and elevate the seller and customer experience on a global scale.
As a Strategic Account Manager on the Amazon Global Selling team, you will work with top Amazon.com sellers, helping them expand their online retail business to Amazon's stores worldwide. You will work with sellers leadership teams, identifying key decision-makers and aligning them to prioritize actions required to expand their online retail business to Amazon's global stores such as Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.com.mx. You will build and cultivate strong relationships with sellers in your portfolio and be a trusted e-commerce and global sales advisor to the leadership in seller organizations. You will partner with external service providers to help your sellers obtain the required tax and product-level compliance certifications for selling in new markets. You will be comfortable with long sales cycles, often lasting more than 8 months, taking sellers through step-by-step processes to launch in a new market. Success in this role will be evaluated based on the scale of the sellers you manage, the number of new markets into which you help your sellers expand, unique selection additions in global markets, and the global sales revenue you drive from sellers in your portfolio. You will utilize a wide range of sales and negotiation skills and work across cross-functional areas to drive the performance of sellers in your portfolio.
In addition to your day-to-day role working with sellers, you will also contribute to business development and identify the correct input metrics that drive business growth for sellers in Amazon's global stores. You will use customer feedback, market growth trends, competitive best practices, and Gen AI developments to suggest new features required in our products and promotional programs to accelerate seller growth or improve the selling partner experience.
Ideal candidates will thrive in an ambiguous and dynamic environment where they must develop, evolve, and implement business strategies to deliver results, have relentlessly high standards, and operate as business owners with end-to-end responsibility to deliver business growth.
Key job responsibilities
• Build strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders in sellers' organizations to drive decisions and actions required to launch sellers' businesses on Amazon's global online stores.
• Pitch CXO-level stakeholders on the benefits of selling their products on Amazon's global online stores in Europe, Asia, and South America.
• Guide sellers through the step-by-step process for global account registration, KYC, tax and product compliance, etc.
• Provide ongoing post-launch support on selection expansion, deals, sponsored ads, etc., to help sellers grow sales on Amazon's global stores.
• Prepare and conduct monthly business reviews with CXO stakeholders in sellers' organizations regarding progress and strategies to increase their revenue on Amazon's global websites.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and program leaders to drive business growth.
• Pilot new initiatives and iterate the existing best practices to improve productivity and impact.
• Identify automation opportunities for manual tasks and partner with Gen AI product team to scale automation across our WW global selling team.
About the team
The Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. We operate with the agility of a startup and a singular mission to empower US-based sellers to expand their businesses worldwide. We are committed to building an AI-native, agentic organization — one where AI agents increasingly handle execution at breadth and speed, while our account management team owns the strategy, the deep insights, the judgment, and the outcomes. The US Global Selling (USGS) team owns the full business lifecycle of North American sellers, expanding them into 20 global markets. Our mission is to make US selections available to customers worldwide. We're dedicated to simplifying global expansion and international selling for US-based sellers, working closely with them on both tech and non-tech aspects of product, supply chain, compliance, and international logistics.

title: Test Lab Manager
description:
Amazon is building the next generation of multi-purpose robotics systems, and scaling from prototype to production. We are looking for an experienced Test Lab Manager to play a key leadership role in proving robots are ready for deployment. This is a chance to join a growing System Verification and Validation team at a pivotal moment and build a lab organization from the ground up. You will own the processes that keep our hardware and physical system test environments running, and you will directly shape how we verify and validate the next generation of Amazon robotics.
As a Test Lab Manager, you will lead a multidisciplinary team of infrastructure, operations, and maintenance staff spanning multiple lab locations that support hardware and physical system testing. Your team runs tests and experiments, operates and maintains test fixtures, lab equipment, control systems, and motion capture systems, coordinates test intake and scheduling, and keeps test uptime high through proactive and corrective maintenance. You will be responsible for standing up new lab spaces, establishing the processes and systems that manage incoming test demand, and growing and developing the team as the lab footprint expands. If you are energized by leading hands-on technical teams, building operational excellence into a scaling organization, and enabling robotics verification and validation, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Lead execution of hardware and physical system test and experimentation campaigns across multiple lab locations, ensuring tests are run safely, on schedule, and with high-quality data in support of verification and validation goals.
- Partner with cross-functional project groups—hardware, software, systems, and quality engineering teams—to understand test requirements, plan lab capacity, and support experimentation from setup through data collection and review.
- Build and own test request intake and management processes and systems, standardizing how test demand is submitted, prioritized, scheduled, and tracked across sites.
- Provide visibility into lab testing activities, capacity, and equipment availability by developing dashboards and reporting that help stakeholders track test status, utilization, and throughput across sites.
- Lead and develop a multidisciplinary lab team (infrastructure, controls, operations, and maintenance staff) across multiple test lab locations, providing coverage across shifts and on-call rotations.
- Own the operation, availability, and uptime of test environments, fixtures, lab equipment, control systems (PLC, I/O), motion capture systems, and environmental test chambers.
- Establish and continuously improve lab operational processes, SOPs, and documentation to enable safe, repeatable, and high-throughput testing.
- Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for lab equipment and electro-mechanical systems to maximize test readiness.
- Stand up new lab spaces, coordinating equipment sourcing, installation, calibration, and onboarding of staff to bring labs online on schedule.
- Ensure safety compliance and manage lab safety protocols specific to robotics hardware testing (e.g., gantry interlocks, robot safety devices, lockout procedures).
A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing the test request queue and the day's schedule across your lab sites, reallocating staff to keep high-priority verification campaigns on track. You could spend part of the day running a hardware test campaign alongside a cross-functional project team, then work with your controls engineers to resolve an issue with an automated test cell. In the afternoon you might refine your test intake process based on feedback from engineering partners, review a dashboard of lab utilization to rebalance capacity, and coach a team member stepping into a new area of ownership. Throughout, you will remove bottlenecks, improve processes, and keep your labs running safely and reliably.
About the team
We are a growing System Verification and Validation organization building the lab infrastructure that validates robotic hardware and physical systems across multiple dimensions of performance and reliability as we scale from prototype to production. This Test Lab Manager role will lead the first dedicated lab engineering organization on the team, spanning multiple sites and disciplines. If you want to help build a lab organization from the ground up and leave your mark on the next generation of Amazon robotics, this is the team to join.

- Experience planning and executing hardware or physical system test or experimentation campaigns in partnership with cross-functional engineering teams

Preferred qualifications: - Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming

- Own the global technical direction for the Games community, partnering with business leadership to align field insights to strategy, prioritizing use cases and customer needs that guide the technical field community outputs.
- Serve as the technical voice of the games market to AWS service teams, product managers, and go-to-market leaders, gathering customer pain points, emerging trends, and competitive intelligence from field engagements and translating them into structured product and roadmap input.
- Drive the creation and scaling of reusable technical artifacts — solutions, workshops, reference architectures, and guidance packages — aligned to prioritized games use cases, and set the quality bar for all games-related technical content published by the community.

The MEGS team operates four industry-aligned Technical Field Communities (Media & Entertainment, Games, Advertising & Marketing Technology, and Betting & Gaming). These communities are the connective tissue between deep domain expertise and field execution at scale. Leadership for the Games Technical Field Community sits within MEGS and brings together the builders from cross cutting technical organizations across AWS who share a passion for the games industry and converge around shared industry challenges to solve customer challenges with field scalable solutions. Our closest partners include the Games sub-industry business leader, AWS service teams, product marketing, go-to-market and account teams worldwide. If you want to combine deep games industry knowledge with the reach and resources of AWS to help customers build what is next, we would love to hear from you.

title: Sensing FEA Engineer
description:
At Apple, outstanding ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring your passion, dedication and expertise to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. We are seeking a finite element analyst to conduct structural, thermal, and dynamic analysis of sensing technologies. Creating the world’s best products means solving some of the most challenging and unique design problems. Please come join us!
You will utilize your expertise in Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to solve engineering problems and discover creative solutions in order to enable robust and reliable sensor technologies. You will perform simulations that will be used to assess performance, design sensitivity, root-cause failure, reliability and much more. As an FEA engineer you will help address engineering challenges with a problem-solving, design-driven mindset to accelerate technology development and deliver world class products. Strong engineering fundamentals in solid mechanics
Preferred qualifications: M.S. degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Structural Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field
In-depth knowledge of FEA and CFD theory, implementation and numerical methods
Experience solving non-linear solid mechanics problems (materials, contact, geometric)
Experience in simulation applied to high volume consumer electronic products and sensor technologies
Experience applying simulation to human anatomy and human-device interaction, including tissue mechanics, physiological responses and human variability, to drive product development and translate these factors into actionable product performance insights, requirements, and specifications.
Experience in additional analysis/simulation areas (biofluid, acoustics, fatigue, and optical biomechanics) and multi-physics simulations
Applied knowledge/experience with material testing & material model calibration
Modeling nonlinear materials such as soft adhesives, elastomers, and polymers
Proficient in Matlab, Python or other scripting language and experience with using AI tools

Experience in data and statistical analysis (Monte Carlo, DOE, statistical process control)
Team-oriented with excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact and collaborate with management, team members and external vendors to achieve project goals, and give positively to the engineering community

Base works in the physical world. A homeowner finds us and decides to trust a new kind of power company. A crew installs the battery. The city approves it, the utility connects it, and we dispatch it, telling it when to charge and when to send power back based on local grid conditions and the member’s usage. Our software has to work inside every one of those steps.

Now we’re going nationwide, and every new state is a new puzzle. The utilities and grids are different. Cities have their own rules. Homeowners think about batteries very differently, too: someone in Houston who lived through a week-long outage sees a home battery differently than someone who has never lost power. Launching a market means learning all of that fast, building software that works there, and then doing it again in the next state.

We’re hiring a forward deployed engineer to go where those problems are.

You’ll embed with the teams and partners behind each launch and learn how their operations really run. What you learn goes back to our Core Experience and Platform teams, so every launch makes the system better.

 - Growth: our sales and marketing teams and the partners who bring homeowners to Base, like homebuilders and channel partners. Build what each new market needs to launch, and scale what works from state to state.

 - Strong product judgment and a track record of turning ambiguous ideas into shipped, useful products

 - Experience in 0-to-1 or fast-moving environments where user needs, product shape, and success metrics are still changing

 - Experience using product analytics, experimentation, and data to guide decisions

 - Intensity and urgency, and a high bar for your own work

Proficiency in designing distributed systems for model training, evaluation, and online inference at petabyte scale
Experience defining AI model governance processes, including producibility, lineage tracking, and automated retaining schedules

title: Café Ambassador - Bellevue
description:
Café Ambassador - Bellevue
The Role
Do you find your purpose in empowering others? As a Café Ambassador, you are the face of Capital One’s mission to change banking for good. We’ve broken the mold of traditional banking—you won’t be found behind a teller line or a glass window. Instead, you’ll move throughout the Café, bridging the gap between digital innovation and human connection.
In this role, you’ll act as a high-end service specialist and a guide to digital banking. You aren't just serving a community; you’re building one by bringing Capital One’s mission to life within a vibrant, modern community hub.
What You’ll Actually Do
Be a Natural Connector: Proactively engage with guests in a high-energy environment that serves as both a community space and a local coffee shop. (Note: You are a banking guide, not a barista—you won’t be serving coffee!)
Serve as a Brand Advocate: You’ll share the value of Capital One’s products and services through genuine conversation rather than transactions. Because we focus on the guest experience, this role is free from traditional sales goals or high-pressure tactics. Your success is measured by the quality of the connection, not a quota.
Simplify the Complex: Guide customers through our digital ecosystem, helping them master mobile tools and troubleshooting tech challenges with ease.
Facilitate Purposeful Impact: Host and support local events that promote financial health. You’ll act as a brand steward, working within the framework of Capital One’s established programs and strategic community partnerships to ensure our impact is professional, focused, and effective.
Advocate & Problem-Solve: You’ll advocate for our customers, problem solve, and own issue resolution in alignment with compliance and regulatory requirements. Handling complaints and/or escalated situations is very important, and de-escalation may be a complex part of your role supporting our customers—we’ll ensure you’re supported with the tools, resources, and experience to ensure you’re up for the challenge!
Act as a Culture Carrier: Foster a supportive, inclusive environment where every guest feels welcome. You’ll be a team player who possesses a strong attention to detail, a positive attitude, and the ability to be flexible and embrace change.
Stay Agile & Engaged: This isn’t a traditional "behind-the-desk" banking role. You’ll be on the move and active throughout the day, moving through the Cafe to connect with the community and support the flow of the guest experience.
Why Join Us?
This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.
The Perks
We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Cafe stronger than when you started.

description:
Data Analysis Manager - Analytics & Transformation
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.
We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Data Analysis Manager to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
What you’ll do:
Drive current and future strategy by leveraging your analytical skills
Assist with building and using models to test and validate data
Work with vast amounts of data in new and evolving environments
Be a part of growing and developing our brand in new and emerging markets
Leverage analytics to create a customer experience above our peers
Lead a team of talented junior analysts on an exciting professional journey while mentoring them and elevating their careers
Be a part of the full life cycle of projects and see end results
Collaborate across business units
Work with top talent in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment where analytics and good data are a top priority
Experience real work life balance, with little travel involved
On any given day you will be:
Mining data to arrive at specific and crucial information for the organization
Identifying and implementing process, data, and reporting improvements for the organization
Working with large and complex databases containing millions to billions of records
Improving operational efficiencies and effectiveness
Conducting analysis to evaluate processes and tests
Extracting and analyzing data to gauge product offerings
Consulting on the design and implementation of new production and data storage systems
Developing and implementing strategic tests of products, initiatives and marketing materials
An ideal candidate will be on the leading edge of Analytical technology with a passion for the newest and most innovative tools. Possessing strong problem solving and conceptual thinking abilities in addition to communication, interpersonal and leadership skills are also important. This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams. At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Data Engineers who are passionate about marrying data with emerging technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across Capital One.
What You’ll Do:
Collaborate with and across Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions in full-stack development tools and technologies
Influence a team of developers, data analysts and data scientists with deep experience in machine learning, distributed microservices, lakehouse architecture, and full-stack systems
Utilize programming languages such as Python and Spark, along with open-source relational and NoSQL databases, and cloud-based data warehousing platforms including Databricks and Snowflake
Share your passion for staying on top of trends in data, experimenting with and learning new technologies, participating in internal and external technology communities, and mentoring other members of the data community
Collaborate with product managers and software engineers to deliver robust cloud-first data solutions that drive powerful experiences to help millions of Americans achieve financial empowerment

Architect and enforce common data engineering design patterns to ensure code quality, maintainability, and reusability across data platforms and pipelines
Serve as an ambassador for the data engineering team, communicating technical concepts and data outcomes clearly to both internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and shared understanding
Design and build data pipelines and platforms with a focus on scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency, ensuring robust performance under increasing data volume and business demands

At least 2 years of experience with SQL

Director - Ecosystem Risk & Integrity - High Brand Risk & Prohibited Investigations
As a Director in Capital One’s Ecosystem Risk & Integrity organization, you will apply your visionary leadership and analytical prowess to safeguard our Global Payments Ecosystem. Leading our High Brand Risk (HBR) and Prohibited Activity Monitoring programs, you will act as a critical first line of defense, working across the enterprise to develop and implement cutting-edge transaction monitoring solutions. In this high-profile role, you will lead a dynamic team of Risk Specialists to ensure participants uphold our network standards and comply with evolving domestic and international regulatory requirements.
Directors in Capital One’s Risk Management organization partner with Executives, network partners, and cross-functional teams to drive organizational change. You will spearhead the modernization of our capabilities to better manage the Company’s risk in an open, collaborative environment where innovative ideas and robust solutions are both welcomed and rewarded.
You are a highly motivated Risk Management professional with a passion for payments integrity, excellent organizational leadership, and strong communication skills. You will have a high level of exposure across lines of business and the opportunity to work directly with Executives to create resilient, forward-thinking strategies. title: Full Time Branch Ambassador - MacArthur
description:
Full Time Branch Ambassador - MacArthur
Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.
As a Branch Ambassador , you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.
We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.
What You’ll Actually Do
The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.
The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.
The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.
The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.
What You Bring
A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.
Why Join Us?
This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.
The Perks
We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Branch stronger than when you started.
Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
Paid Time Off
Education Assistance
Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
Paid Parental Leave
Mental Health support
Back-up Child or Elder Care
And much more!
Essential Functions (Included, but not limited to)
Support surrounding Branches as needed within a 50 mile radius, with occasional opportunities to assist other locations in the broader Region.
Available to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, with hours and days subject to change.
While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
Regular and consistent attendance
Basic Qualifications
High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience
At least 6 months of cash handling experience
Preferred Qualifications
Associate’s degree
2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
Proficient in G-Suite
Strong written and oral communication skills
After you apply
You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.
Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The Global Network Analytics (GNA) team—specifically within our Foundational AI & Automation pillar—builds machine learning engines and AI agents to drive foundational, scalable intelligence across the payments ecosystem. We create core models and AI tools to power merchant intelligence, acceptance growth, fraud/risk decisioning, and enterprise automation.
In this role, you will:
Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered capabilities that evaluate billions of network transactions and transform merchant intelligence.
Leverage a modern tech stack—PyTorch, AWS, VectorDBs, and LLMs—to extract actionable insights from complex numerical, tabular, and textual data feeds.
Serve as the domain expert in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs), adapting, fine-tuning, and working with technology to deploy them for business users.
Translate technical ML complexity into tangible business value and strategic goals.
The Ideal Candidate is:
Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You're passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
Technical. You’re comfortable with advanced ML and DL technologies including language models and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience working with LLMs and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Influential. You are passionate about AI/ML and can bring along a cross functional team in breakthrough innovations. You communicate clearly and effectively to share your findings with non-technical audiences.
You are experienced in training language models as well as have expertise in one or more key subdomains such as: training optimization, self-supervised learning, explainability, RLHF.
You have an engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in training data and inference volumes. You have experience in delivering libraries, platforms, or solution level code to existing products.

Mobile Engineer 5 ( Android) (Enterprise Platforms Technology )
Do you love building and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. As a Mobile Engineer, you’ll be at the forefront of driving a major transformation across the enterprise.
At Capital One, the iOS and Android platforms are recognized as an opportunity to reach our customers in unique, personal and engaging ways. Nothing is off-limits as we explore exciting ways to take advantage of the full ecosystem of mobile devices, including Watch, TV, and whatever future developments Apple or Google creates. Our engineers are provided with top-of-the-line MacBook Pros, multiple high-end monitors and the necessary tooling to develop the best possible products with the least amount of friction. We operate in small, productive Agile teams and use the best industry tools to collaborate cross-functionally.
Enterprise Platforms Technology (EPTech) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We play an essential role in establishing practices for building technology solutions across the company, while also delivering capabilities that exemplify those practices.
What You’ll Do:
Partner with software engineers, designers, and product managers to deliver high-performing, quality features for 100M+ customers that are engaging, purposeful and powerful in their simplicity
Partner with product leaders to influence multi-quarter engineering roadmaps (e.g., new capability builds, performance optimization, platform modernization) ensuring alignment with broader business goals
Architect, build, and maintain core components and shared libraries that act as a force multiplier for multiple teams within your product area
Contribute to standards for cross-platform consistency, scalability, and accessibility across mobile experiences
Serve as a subject matter expert in critical areas like mobile performance, networking, or platform-specific UI frameworks, influencing standards across teams
Partner with infrastructure and backend teams to define and improve mobile CI/CD, observability, and reliability engineering practices, standardizing release practices
Define strategies for leveraging agentic AI tools across multiple teams, including specialized agents, skills and tools built on open standards (e.g., Model Context Protocol), to standardize workflows
Mentor and guide senior engineers in building AI-native workflows, shaping the next generation of technical leaders proficient in agentic coding
Apply mastery of the modern mobile ecosystem (including deep platform-specific capabilities and advanced UI patterns) to make complex, high-leverage, hands-on technical contributions that solve the most challenging problems within your product area
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)
At least 6 years of professional experience in software engineering, mobile architectural design and project execution across multiple teams (internship experience does not apply)
At least 6 years of experience building native mobile applications for Android or iOS
At least 3 years of experience architecting or leading the development of federated native mobile applications
Preferred Qualifications:
7+ years experience building native mobile applications for Android or iOS
Proven experience with modern native UI frameworks (e.g., SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose)
Proven experience with designing and building automated testing suites for mobile (e.g., Swift Testing, XCUI, JUnit, Espresso)
Proven experience with modular architecture and modern state management patterns
Proven experience with performance tuning and optimization on native mobile platforms
Experience providing technical leadership for a large product area, influencing its technical vision and roadmap
Experience leading the design of multi-team components or contributing to shared SDKs
Experience developing and scaling client Backend-for-Frontends (BFFs) and defining efficient data-fetching strategies using protocols like gRPC/Protobuf
Working knowledge of on-device ML frameworks (e.g., CoreML, TensorFlow Lite)
Expertise in release health indicators, metrics-driven staged rollout, and feature flag strategies
Expertise with agentic AI coding tools and developer productivity patterns

title: Principal Associate, Accounting
location: Richmond, VA; McLean, VA; Wilmington, DE
description:
Principal Associate, Accounting
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As part of our newly formed Centralized Card Data Team , we sit at the top of the Card Product Controllers (CPC) organization and act as the definitive voice for all Card Accounting data needs. We are bridging the gap between raw data infrastructure and downstream financial reporting, turning data management from a back-office task into a core strategic advantage.
As a Principal Associate on the Card Data Team, you will leverage your data governance and strategic skills to provide early leadership on fast-moving data projects and provide leadership. You will act as an embedded Business Steward, balancing the need to accelerate our digital transformation with the need to follow strict regulatory frameworks.
On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Data Stewardship, Data Governance, and Operations:
Data Stewardship & Consultation
Partner Across Teams: Serve as the primary liaison and data contact for the Card Product Controllers team, working closely with technical and business teams.
Strategic Guidance: Provide early consultation on major enterprise initiatives to guarantee Card-specific accounting requirements are addressed.
Business Stewardship: Focus on "Trust" and "Compliance" by defining data meaning and usage, while partnering closely with Technical Data Stewards who handle storage and movement.
​
Data Governance & Management
Quality Processes: Establish and run standardized processes for data quality protocols, profiling, and defining Critical Data Elements and usage.
Data Delivery Agreements: Help define operational contracts, Data Provisioning Agreements (DPAs), and SLAs (covering delivery times, cadence, and source system cut-offs) to streamline downstream consumption.
​
Operations & Knowledge Management
Risk Reduction: Promote a controlled change management environment to reduce data risk and eliminate the manual overhead spent investigating "out-of-balance" exceptions. Performing outage audits/retros to identify data improvement opportunities that can limit our speed to market strategy.
Team Advocacy: Serve as the definitive voice for the team, educating consumers on new data standards, supporting operational integration with the Speed to Market team, and preparing executive updates.
​
Our ideal candidate will have:
A high level of comfort operating independently in an ambiguous, "startup-like" environment within a newly formed team.
The ability to tackle big foundational tasks from scratch, such as establishing dataset inventories and data quality rules.
Strong communication skills to translate complex technical constraints into clear business impacts, and vice versa.
The ability to build trust and influence cross-functional partners, including Product Owners, Tech, and Financial Data Management.
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree or military experience
At least 3 years of experience in accounting, external financial reporting, audit, finance, or a combination
At least 3 years of experience with Google Office or Microsoft Office products, or a combination
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s Degree in Finance, Analytics, or a related quantitative field
Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license or Project Management Professional (PMP) designation
5+ years of progressive experience working in data analytics, data governance, business intelligence, or financial data systems
4+ years of experience working directly within a financial institution, supporting Product Controllers, Finance or general ledger data infrastructure
2+ years of experience in Tableau, Python, or SQL, or a combination
Familiarity with Agile operating models, writing logical rules and requirements, and integrating data controls directly into a delivery pipeline

title: Principal Associate, Data Scientist - People Strategy & Analytics
description:
Principal Associate, Data Scientist - People Strategy & Analytics
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.
Team Description
People Strategy & Analytics brings data, analytics, and insights to shape critical talent decisions and strategy at Capital One. We work closely with HR partners and senior executives in shaping talent policy, automating real-time data, and improving talent decision-making. The team is comprised of people with diverse skills and backgrounds including: data analysts, data scientists, business analysts, HR specialists, project managers, and industrial/organizational psychologists.
As a Data Scientist on Capital One’s People Strategy & Analytics team, you’ll be on the leading edge of applying analytics to talent, combining artificial intelligence, machine learning, and social science to build models that seek to understand associate behavior, improve HR efficiency and tools, and inform strategies aimed at expanding Capital One’s talent advantage.
Role Description
In this role, you will:
Build natural language processing and machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Apply expertise in using open source large language models (LLMs) through prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and evaluation metric frameworks for business specific applications
Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, business analysts, and product managers to deliver industry leading HR tools and AI-powered products
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, SQL, AWS, LangChain, Hugging Face Transformers, VectorDBs, Pytorch/TensorFlow, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within large volumes of numeric and textual data
Flex your interpersonal skills to collaborate with internal stakeholders, translating complex data science work into tangible, aligned business outcomes.
The Ideal Candidate is:
Passionate about human capital: You are excited by the value we can add to our company and our associates, and are inspired to help make a large positive impact.
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
Basic Qualifications:
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 5 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 3 years of experience performing data analytics
A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics, or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
At least 3 years’ experience in Python
At least 3 years’ experience with machine learning
At least 3 years’ experience with SQL
At least 2 years’ experience with relational databases such as Snowflake
At least 2 years’ experience with AI/ML tools and ecosystems such as Hugging Face, VectorDBs or Pytorch/TensorFlow

title: Principal Associate, Process Management - Content Marketing (Hybrid)
description:
Principal Associate, Process Management - Content Marketing (Hybrid)
Capital One, one of Fortune Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For,” is looking for an organized, data-driven Principal Process Manager to join our team. The Content Marketing Process Manager will help shape our operational direction and day-to-day execution plans. They will oversee article publishing across Capital One’s Learn & Grow and Discover’s Card Smarts content hubs, partnering closely with Content Strategy and Marketing teams to keep publishing efficient and aligned with business priorities.
This role combines project management, clear process improvement, and task prioritization to deliver real operational results. This person will proactively identify and solve organizational needs before they become roadblocks, turning complex workflows into clear, repeatable processes.
The ideal candidate is dedicated to maintaining high quality standards and constantly looks for ways to simplify and improve workflows.
Responsibilities
Manage day-to-day article publishing across Capital One and Discover content hubs, including directing contractor work to ensure priority content is published smoothly
Partner with Content Marketing teammates to plan and carry out operational updates, such as platform improvements and tool integrations, that improve results
Develop and maintain process documentation and drive continuous process improvements
Perform quality assurance checks on actions taken to ensure accuracy
Ensure our processes meet risk and compliance standards, making governance a clear, useful part of how we work and innovate
Manage a fluid publishing model, monitoring resource capacity and dynamic priorities to maintain a consistent publishing output
Act as the primary point of contact across teams, collaborating closely with business analysts, marketing, legal/risk, and platform teams to keep projects on track
​
The ideal candidate:
Convert long-term goals into clear, actionable plans that keep projects moving forward
Proactively identify solutions to open-ended problems and build strong cross-functional partnerships
Independently balance multiple competing tasks in a fast-paced environment
Communicate clearly and persuasively with teammates and senior leaders alike
Maintain a strong attention to detail and deliver high-quality work consistently
Navigate uncertain situations with clarity, accountability, and a focus on customer needs
Build supportive relationships with internal partners to ensure smooth execution
Simplify and improve internal workflows to remove inefficiencies
Set up clear project structures to manage complex projects effectively
Adapt quickly to changing priorities and team requirements
Collaborate well with others, ensuring partners across the organization feel included and supported
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
At least 3 years of Process Management or Project Management experience
At least 1 year of experience in Microsoft Office or G Suite
​
Preferred Qualifications:
4+ years of Project or Process Management experience
2+ years of experience utilizing modern digital tools, such as google suite, social media platforms, or content management systems
1+ years of experience working with digital marketing & content publishing operations

- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to a wide range of audiences.
- Drive to develop and maintain high quality and transparent model documentation.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Senior Associate Product Management - Encore Processing
Product Management
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

About the Team:
The Encore Processing Product Management organization drives the strategy and execution of Capital One’s Card Processing ecosystem. Our team is at the epicenter of Card Growth—delivering critical capabilities for major card network integrations (e.g., Discover), driving legacy system updates (e.g., Bridges), and building an ultra-resilient, highly available processing engine.
As the Senior Associate PM you are the engine behind our primary product delivery. You are a flexible, highly detail-oriented product manager who spans horizontal work across backend architecture and business operations. Whether you are validating payment logic for major portfolio conversions, analyzing edge cases for disaster recovery resiliency, or untangling complex cardholder data, your work directly protects customer experiences and directly enables business value for Card.

Human Centered

Customer Resiliency: Ensure zero disruption to customer payment behavior during major conversions and system updates.
Update Systems: Help untangle dependencies by identifying opportunities for advanced "bridge and peel away" solutions.
Elevate Platform Quality: Deeply investigate process breakdowns to drive down reliance on manual "Catch & Fix" remedies.

Intellectually Curious . You ask why, you explore, you're not afraid to blurt out your crazy idea or follow an email chain for weeks to find someone with an answer. Comfortable with ambiguity, a hunger to learn and a seeker of new challenges

Do-er. You’re biased toward action, you try things and sometimes you fail. You can get around roadblocks and stay focused on your goals. You’re well organized, able to multitask and able to prioritize your work

At Capital One, we believe great products begin with a deep understanding of our customers. From our earliest days, we pioneered the use of predictive modeling to individually personalize credit card offers, turning the entire industry on its head. As we’ve grown bigger, we’ve found more and more ways to use technology and face-to-face conversations to understand the human problems associated with money and finances.

We’ve challenged ourselves to spend less time planning, more time doing, and, above all else, to see the world through the eyes of our customers as they work to understand and manage their money.
Are you passionate about improving the way people interact with their money? Are you driven by the delight you bring to customers? Do you keep asking “why” until you hit the root? It’s common to fall in love with solutions, but have you ever fallen in love with the problem? Do you have an opinion on whether shipping is more important than perfection? Do you have a healthy dose of skepticism for the impossible? If you’re nodding your head, then we want you!

They focus on building and maintaining strong client relationships with businesses in the $2mm-$20mm space within their assigned market.
Primary responsibilities include meeting with prospects to bring in new relationships, developing strong COIs in the marketplace, and closing new business opportunities. This role places a strong emphasis on prospecting and business development, as well as deepening relationships with existing clients.

Proactively generates new business by prospecting for deposits, lending, treasury management, merchant services and other banking solutions.
Meet with prospects to bring in new relationships, develop strong COI relationships in your market, and close new business opportunities to grow the bank’s client base and revenue.
Build and maintain a robust network of centers of influence (COI’s), including CPA’s, attorneys, commercial real estate agents, and other professionals, to drive referrals and business growth.
Retain and manage clients within your portfolio, with a focus on deepening relationships and cross selling additional products and services to meet client needs.
Collaborate with the Business Banking Client Service team to deliver exceptional service and ensure a seamless banking experience for all clients.
Maintain a strong understanding of Capital One’s credit policy, ensuring compliance while effectively evaluating and mitigating risk.

Capital One and Discover are building the next generation of payment capabilities to power a modern, secure, and next-gen global network. Within Network Risk Operations, our Ecosystem Risk & Integrity (ERI) function sits at the tip of the spear of a technology and AI revolution - leveraging sophisticated algorithms, rich data, and deep risk expertise to safeguard the security and integrity of the network. Within ERI, we are standing up a brand-new Participant Consultation function designed to partner with our client-facing teams and collaborate with our ecosystem participants (US and abroad) to develop and lead programs. Principal focus will be architecting data-driven strategies to actively mitigate fraud while maximizing authorization approval rates, reducing checkout friction, and decreasing chargeback exposure across the ecosystem. Additionally, client projects may cover an array of related topics ranging across risk strategy, product optimization, growth strategy, customer segmentation and digital tools .
We are seeking a visionary leader to establish, build, and scale this function from the ground up. Operating at the intersection of client services, risk management, you will partner directly with senior executives and client-facing teams to identify opportunities, improve participant performance, and drive superior payment outcomes across authorizations, fraud, and disputes.
As a 0-to-1 builder, you bring a rare combination of high-level strategy and hands-on execution - capable of establishing governance and vision while driving projects to completion to deliver measurable impact.
Job Responsibilities (What You'll Do)
Build & Scale 0-to-1 Capabilities: Design, launch, and scale a new operational, advisory, and risk function within Ecosystem Risk & Intelligence—defining the operational framework, core performance metrics, engagement models, and advisory cadence from scratch.
Bridge Strategy & Operational Execution: Transition seamlessly between executive-level strategy and hands-on operational execution to build a high-yielding, respected network function.
Lead Global Payments & Scheme Operations: Apply deep domain expertise in global payment network dynamics, authorization processing, fraud management frameworks, chargebacks, and scheme regulations to optimize network performance.
Drive Partner Co-Creation & Client Engagement: Collaborate with senior management and client-facing teams to deeply understand participant needs, delivering tailored operational recommendations that drive volume, trust, and throughput.
Execute International Commercial Strategy: Direct and oversee on-the-ground commercial execution and localized operations across multiple international regions outside the U.S.
Synthesize Transactional Data into Actionable Strategy: Query, analyze, and translate complex transactional data into executive-level narratives, structured action plans, and data-backed business decisions.
Navigate Matrixed Stakeholder Relationships: Guide cross-functional teams, build alignment with technical product partners, and influence senior leaders across all levels of a matrixed organization.
Deliver Executive Storytelling & Briefings: Independently author and present high-yield briefs, strategic memos, and leadership presentations to C-suite and senior executives.
Build & Manage High-Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and retain a world-class team, fostering talent development while establishing disciplined program governance and outcome tracking to achieve shared objectives.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 20% of the time

About the Team
The Customer Identity and Core team (CIC) is part of Capital One’s Enterprise Product and Experience organization. The CIC team is responsible for managing the enterprise system of record for over 100 million customers, including consumers, businesses and devices, enabling access to the company’s customer experiences, providing customer and business intelligence, and protecting critical customer account information at the highest level of security.
The products built by our team are foundational for creating seamless customer experiences, keeping customer financial well-being safe and secure, and unlocking business growth by providing a full picture of each unique human Capital One serves. Capital One is building out an exciting new Customer Data Platform on graph-based infrastructure in order to manage the evolving complexities of our business. description:
Senior Manager, Data Analyst - Product Analytics
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
The Enterprise Data team is focused on maximizing the value of our data ecosystem and enabling real-time, intelligent experiences built on a scalable, future ready foundation. We are a highly collaborative, cross-functional team working across Product, Technology, Design, Risk, and other partners to build a modern enterprise data ecosystem.
We are looking for an exceptional and innovative Sr. Manager, Data Analytics to solve complex business and product challenges across our Enterprise Data Product teams. You will lead Product Analytics to measure and improve the performance and health of our Products and Platforms, transforming complex data into actionable, AI-enabled insights that shape product strategy and drive better decisions. If you are a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex problems and using Data and AI to influence product development, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
On a given day you will be:
Refining a new Enterprise-wide analytical tools validation framework
Planning and executing validation projects
Assessing the quality and risk of analytical tool methodologies across Capital One, and the nature of tools usage within those processes
Understanding technical issues in analytical tools and assessing tools risks and opportunities
Independently researching, identifying, and prototyping industry best practices for emerging analytical tools
Communicating results clearly and concisely both verbally and through written communications via validation reports and presentations
Leveraging education, colleagues and training opportunities to develop solutions to business problems
Coaching and mentoring junior staff

This position will be in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment where you will be handling multiple concurrent projects while working independently and in teams.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 7 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.

At least 5 years of experience in financial services industry

We are currently seeking a Lead Designer who has a passion for solving tough challenges to join our team. Product Design Expertise: Demonstrate established expertise in product design, leveraging a variety of skills across interaction, visual and service design; in collaboration with cross-functional partners, help to oversee and optimize the use of appropriate tools, platforms, frameworks and design systems and work with your team to develop artifacts that may include vision stories, journey maps, blueprints, high-fidelity designs and prototypes

Senior Manager, Product Management (PXDP55)

title: Senior Manager, Quantitative Analysis - Model Risk Office
description:
Senior Manager, Quantitative Analysis - Model Risk Office
At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
As a Quantitative Senior Manager at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in cloud computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.
As part of the Model Risk function, you will partner with high-performing model development teams and model risk teams responsible for advance Capital One’s Loan Loss Forecasting and Allowance for Credit Losses (ACL) framework. You will provide effective challenge on quantitative models, evaluating conceptual and statistical soundness, performance under economic stress scenarios, and alignment with model policy. The ideal candidate brings deep retail credit risk expertise, strong regulatory knowledge, and a proven track record of driving rigorous model challenge.
Responsibilities and Skills:
- Remain on the leading edge of analytical technology with a passion for the newest and most innovative tools.
- Develop alternative model approaches to assess model design and advance future capabilities.
- Understand relevant business processes and portfolios associated with model use.
- Understand technical issues in econometric, statistical, and machine learning modeling and apply these skills toward developing models and assessing model risks and opportunities.
- Communicate technical subject matter clearly and concisely to individuals from various backgrounds both verbally and through written communication; prepare presentations of complex technical concepts and research results to non-specialist audiences and senior management.
- Maintain the efficiency and accuracy of our models through continuous improvement and application of best practices.
- Develop and maintain high quality and transparent documentation.
- Leverage the latest open source technologies and tools to identify areas of opportunity in our existing framework.
Expertise in quantitative analysis is central to our success in all markets. Our modelers thrive in a culture of mutual respect, excellence and innovation.
Successful candidates would possess:
- Demonstrated track-record in modeling and experience utilizing model estimation tools such as Python or R.
- Ability to clearly communicate modeling results to management, model risk office, regulator and other modelers.
- Drive to continuously improve all aspects of their work in a collaborative fashion.
- Experience in machine learning.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to quickly understand existing models and new requirements/business needs.
- Experience working with Agile development methodologies.
- Strong grasp of econometric theory and methodologies.
- Desire to remain on the leading edge of analytical technology with a passion for the newest and most innovative tools.
Basic Qualifications:
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an exception that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: A Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 5 years of experience in quantitative analytics
A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience in quantitative analytics
At least 5 years of experience in each of the following skills through education or experience: Statistical or econometric modeling
Linear and logistic regression
Programming in R, Python, or SQL
Presenting statistical concepts and research results to non-statistical audience
At least 5 years of experience in at least 3 of the following skills: Survival analysis modeling
Time-series analysis
Panel data (longitudinal data or cross-sectional time-series data) analysis
Cross-sectional data analysis
Machine learning
Analysis and management of large datasets (>1M records)
Preferred Qualifications:
6 years of experience with Python, R or other statistical analyst software
6 years of experience in statistical modeling or regression analytics or machine learning
2 years of experience managing people

Sr Manager, Product Management - HR Products & Data
Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.
About the Team
Are you ready to tackle one of our most critical global data challenges? We're looking for an innovative and driven individual contributor Product Manager to own the strategy, discovery, and implementation of a next-generation Fine-Grain Access Control (FGAC) solution across our enterprise HR data ecosystem. Additionally, you’ll be a key member of the People Data leadership team shaping the enterprise HR data ecosystem strategy.

Your work will be central to protecting sensitive international workforce data, ensuring global compliance, and enabling the secure growth of our HR product suite. If you are passionate about data governance, security, and delivering foundational enterprise capabilities, this is the high-impact role you've been waiting for.

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions

Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value

description:
Sr. Director, Applied Researcher
At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.
Team Description:
The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business.
This is a people leader role that will lead teams to drive strategic direction through collaboration with Applied Science, Engineering and Product leaders across Capital One. As a well-respected technologist and people leader, you will guide and mentor a team of applied scientists. You will be expected to be an external leader representing Capital One in the research community, collaborating with prominent faculty members in the relevant AI research community.
What You’ll Do:
Partner with a cross-functional team of applied researchers, data scientists, AI engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how customers interact with their money.
Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data.
Build and apply AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation.
Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences.
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals.
Set the strategic research vision and roadmap for the organization, ensuring alignments between long-term scientific discovery and business transformation priorities
The Ideal Candidate:
You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond
Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms
Have a deep, first-principles understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies
Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, different flavors of RL
Experience building production grade systems that deliver large scale business impact.
An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes
Experience in delivering libraries, platform level code or solution level code to existing products
A professional with a track record of coming up with high quality ideas or improving upon existing ideas in machine learning, demonstrated by accomplishments such as first author publications or projects
